  public query ({ caller }) func getCallerUserProfile() : async ?UserProfile {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access profiles");
    };
    userProfiles.get(caller);
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getUserProfile(user : Principal) : async ?UserProfile {
    if (caller != user and not AccessControl.isAdmin(accessControlState, caller)) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only view your own profile");
    };
    userProfiles.get(user);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func saveCallerUserProfile(profile : UserProfile) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can save profiles");
    };
    userProfiles.add(caller, profile);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func checkConsent(consentType : ConsentType) : async Bool {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can check consent");
    };

    switch (userConsents.get(caller)) {
      case (null) { false };
      case (?record) {
        switch (consentType) {
          case (#firstVisit) {
            switch (record.firstVisit) {
              case (#accepted _) { true };
              case (#notAccepted) { false };
            };
          };
          case (#sellerOnboarding) {
            switch (record.sellerOnboarding) {
              case (#accepted _) { true };
              case (#notAccepted) { false };
            };
          };
        };
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func acceptConsent(consentType : ConsentType, acceptanceData : ?Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can accept consent");
    };

    let timestamp = Time.now();
    let acceptanceStatus : ConsentStatus = #accepted({
      timestamp;
      acceptanceData;
    });

    let newRecord = switch (userConsents.get(caller)) {
      case (null) {
        {
          firstVisit = if (consentType == #firstVisit) { acceptanceStatus } else { #notAccepted };
          sellerOnboarding = if (consentType == #sellerOnboarding) { acceptanceStatus } else { #notAccepted };
        };
      };
      case (?record) {
        switch (consentType) {
          case (#firstVisit) {
            { record with firstVisit = acceptanceStatus };
          };
          case (#sellerOnboarding) {
            { record with sellerOnboarding = acceptanceStatus };
          };
        };
      };
    };

    userConsents.add(caller, newRecord);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func sellerOnboardingConsent(acceptanceData : ?Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can accept onboarding consent");
    };

    let timestamp = Time.now();
    let acceptance : ConsentStatus = #accepted({
      timestamp;
      acceptanceData;
    });

    let newRecord = switch (userConsents.get(caller)) {
      case (null) {
        {
          firstVisit = #notAccepted;
          sellerOnboarding = acceptance;
        };
      };
      case (?record) {
        { record with sellerOnboarding = acceptance };
      };
    };

    userConsents.add(caller, newRecord);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func firstVisitConsent(acceptanceData : ?Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can accept first visit consent");
    };

    let timestamp = Time.now();
    let acceptance : ConsentStatus = #accepted({
      timestamp;
      acceptanceData;
    });

    let newRecord = switch (userConsents.get(caller)) {
      case (null) {
        {
          firstVisit = acceptance;
          sellerOnboarding = #notAccepted;
        };
      };
      case (?record) {
        { record with firstVisit = acceptance };
      };
    };

    userConsents.add(caller, newRecord);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func subscribeToStore(storeId : Principal) : async () {
    if (storeId == caller) {
      Runtime.trap("You cannot subscribe to your own store");
    };

    let access = AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user);
    if (not access) { Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can subscribe to stores. ") };

    let userSubscriptions = getOrCreateSubscriptionSet(caller);

    if (userSubscriptions.contains(storeId)) {
      Runtime.trap("Already subscribed to store");
    };

    userSubscriptions.add(storeId);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func unsubscribeFromStore(storeId : Principal) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can unsubscribe from stores");
    };

    let userSubscriptions = getOrCreateSubscriptionSet(caller);

    if (not userSubscriptions.contains(storeId)) {
      Runtime.trap("You are not subscribed to this store");
    };

    userSubscriptions.remove(storeId);
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getSubscribedStores() : async [Principal] {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access subscribed stores");
    };

    switch (storeSubscriptions.get(caller)) {
      case (null) { [] };
      case (?storeSet) { storeSet.toArray() };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func isUserSubscribedToStore(storeId : Principal) : async Bool {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can check subscriptions");
    };

    switch (storeSubscriptions.get(caller)) {
      case (null) { false };
      case (?storeSet) { storeSet.contains(storeId) };
    };
  };

  public query func getStoreSubscriberCount(storeId : Principal) : async Nat {
    var subscriberCount = 0;
    for (
      (user, subscriptions) in storeSubscriptions.entries()
    ) {
      if (subscriptions.contains(storeId)) {
        subscriberCount += 1;
      };
    };
    subscriberCount;
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getMyStoreSubscriberCount() : async Nat {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access store subscriber count");
    };

    let storeId = caller;
    var subscriberCount = 0;
    for ((user, subscriptions) in storeSubscriptions.entries()) {
      if (subscriptions.contains(storeId)) {
        subscriberCount += 1;
      };
    };
    subscriberCount;
  };

  func getOrCreateSubscriptionSet(user : Principal) : Set.Set<Principal> {
    switch (storeSubscriptions.get(user)) {
      case (null) {
        let newSet = Set.empty<Principal>();
        storeSubscriptions.add(user, newSet);
        newSet;
      };
      case (?set) { set };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func likeProduct(productId : Text) : async (Nat, Nat, Nat) {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can like products");
    };

    let userLikeSet = registerOrGetSet(caller, userLikes);

    if (userLikeSet.contains(productId)) {
      Runtime.trap("Product already liked by user");
    };

    userLikeSet.add(productId);

    let product = products.get(productId).unwrap();

    let updatedProduct = {
      product with
      likeCount = product.likeCount + 1;
    };

    products.add(productId, updatedProduct);

    (updatedProduct.likeCount, updatedProduct.commentCount, updatedProduct.saveCount);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func addComment(productId : Text, content : Text) : async (Nat, Nat, Nat) {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can add comments");
    };

    let commentId = productId # "_" # caller.toText() # "_" # Time.now().toText();
    let newComment : Comment = {
      id = commentId;
      productId = productId;
      author = caller;
      content = content;
      timestamp = Time.now();
    };
    comments.add(commentId, newComment);

    let product = products.get(productId).unwrap();

    products.add(
      productId,
      {
        product with
        commentCount = product.commentCount + 1;
      },
    );

    let updatedProduct = products.get(productId).unwrap();

    addProductComment(productId, newComment);

    (updatedProduct.likeCount, updatedProduct.commentCount, updatedProduct.saveCount);
  };

  func addProductComment(productId : Text, comment : Comment) {
    switch (productComments.get(productId)) {
      case (null) {
        let newCommentList = List.empty<Comment>();
        newCommentList.add(comment);
        productComments.add(productId, newCommentList);
      };
      case (?existingComments) {
        existingComments.add(comment);
      };
    };
  };

  public query func getProductComments(productId : Text) : async [Comment] {
    let commentsArray = switch (productComments.get(productId)) {
      case (null) { [] };
      case (?comments) { comments.toArray() };
    };

    commentsArray.sort<Comment>(
      func(a, b) { Int.compare(a.timestamp, b.timestamp) }
    );
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func saveProduct(productId : Text) : async (Nat, Nat, Nat) {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can save products");
    };

    let userSaved = savedProducts.get(caller);

    switch (userSaved) {
      case (null) {
        let newSet = Set.empty<Text>();
        newSet.add(productId);
        savedProducts.add(caller, newSet);
      };
      case (?set) {
        set.add(productId);
      };
    };

    let product = products.get(productId).unwrap();

    let updatedProduct = {
      product with
      saveCount = product.saveCount + 1;
    };

    products.add(productId, updatedProduct);

    (updatedProduct.likeCount, updatedProduct.commentCount, updatedProduct.saveCount);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func unsaveProduct(productId : Text) : async (Nat, Nat, Nat) {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can unsave products");
    };

    switch (savedProducts.get(caller)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Product not saved by user") };
      case (?set) {
        if (not set.contains(productId)) {
          Runtime.trap("Product not saved by user");
        };
        set.remove(productId);
      };
    };

    switch (products.get(productId)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Product does not exist") };
      case (?product) {
        let newCount = if (product.saveCount > 0) {
          product.saveCount - 1;
        } else { 0 };
        products.add(
          productId,
          { product with saveCount = newCount },
        );
      };
    };

    let p = products.get(productId).unwrap();
    (p.likeCount, p.commentCount, p.saveCount);
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getSavedProducts() : async [Product] {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access saved products");
    };

    switch (savedProducts.get(caller)) {
      case (null) { [] };
      case (?set) {
        let savedIds = set.toArray();
        savedIds.filter(func(id) { products.containsKey(id) }).map<Text, Product>(
          func(id) { products.get(id).unwrap() },
        );
      };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getUserLikedProducts() : async [Product] {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access liked products");
    };

    switch (userLikes.get(caller)) {
      case (null) { [] };
      case (?set) {
        let likedIds = set.toArray();
        likedIds.filter(func(id) { products.containsKey(id) }).map<Text, Product>(
          func(id) { products.get(id).unwrap() },
        );
      };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getUserComments() : async [Comment] {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access comments");
    };

    comments.values().toArray().filter(func(c) { c.author == caller });
  };

  public query func getProductMedia(productId : Text) : async ?ProductMedia {
    switch (products.get(productId)) {
      case (null) { null };
      case (?product) { ?product.media };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func searchProductsForAssistant(productQuery : ProductQuery) : async ProductSearchResult {
    let allProducts = products.values().toArray();

    var filtered = allProducts;

    switch (productQuery.searchTerm) {
      case (?term) {
        filtered := filtered.filter(
          func(product) {
            product.name.contains(#text term) or
            product.description.contains(#text term)
          }
        );
      };
      case (null) {};
    };

    switch (productQuery.priceRange) {
      case (?(min, max)) {
        filtered := filtered.filter(func(p) { p.price >= min and p.price <= max });
      };
      case (null) {};
    };

    switch (productQuery.storeId) {
      case (?id) {
        filtered := filtered.filter(func(p) { p.storeId == id });
      };
      case (null) {};
    };

    filtered := filtered.sort(
      func(a, b) {
        let aIsGolden = switch (a.tier) {
          case (#goldenRegular) { true };
          case (#goldenInstagramTagged) { true };
          case (#stockProduct) { false };
        };
        let bIsGolden = switch (b.tier) {
          case (#goldenRegular) { true };
          case (#goldenInstagramTagged) { true };
          case (#stockProduct) { false };
        };

        if (aIsGolden and not bIsGolden) {
          #less;
        } else if (not aIsGolden and bIsGolden) {
          #greater;
        } else {
          #equal;
        };
      }
    );

    switch (productQuery.sortBy) {
      case (? #priceAsc) {
        filtered := filtered.sort(
          func(a, b) { Nat.compare(a.price, b.price) }
        );
      };
      case (? #priceDesc) {
        filtered := filtered.sort(
          func(a, b) { Nat.compare(b.price, a.price) }
        );
      };
      case (? #relevance) {};
      case (null) {};
    };

    let assistantResponse = switch (filtered.size()) {
      case (0) { "Kechirasiz, so'rovingizga mos keladigan mahsulotlarni topa olmadim. Iltimos, aniqroq izlash uchun mahsulot nomini, narx oralig'ini yoki do'koningiz raqamini kiriting." };
      case (1) { "Ajoyib! Sizning so'rovingizga mos keluvchi bitta mahsulotni topdim. Agar ko'proq mahsulotlarga qiziqsangiz yoki boshqa talablaringiz bo'lsa, iltimos, ular haqida ma'lumot bering." };
      case (_) {
        "Ajoyib! Sizning so'rovingizga mos keluvchi " # filtered.size().toText() # " ta mahsulotni topdim. Ko'proq mahsulotlarni ko'rish yoki izlash parametrlari bo'yicha yordam olmoqchi bo'lsangiz, menga xabar bering";
      };
    };

    {
      filteredProducts = filtered;
      assistantAnswer = assistantResponse;
    };
  };

  func findMostRelevantAnswer(knowledgeBase : Text, question : Text) : ?Text {
    if (knowledgeBase.contains(#text question)) {
      let sliceEnd = if (knowledgeBase.size() < 200) { knowledgeBase.size() } else { 200 };
      ?Text.fromIter(knowledgeBase.toIter().take(sliceEnd));
    } else {
      null;
    };
  };

  func getFallbackResponse(_ : Text) : Text {
    "Siz so'ragan savol bo'yicha hozircha aniq ma'lumotlarga ega emasman. " #
    "Iltimos, savolingiz yoki so'rovingiz haqida ko'proq tafsilotlarni taqdim eting. " #
    "Misol uchun, sizni qiziqtirgan mahsulotning nomi, narxi yoki do'kon haqida ma'lumotni yozing. " #
    "Qo'shimcha savol yoki izlash parametrlari bilan yordam bera olaman.";
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getStoreAssistantOutput(storeId : Principal, question : Text) : async Text {
    switch (storeProfiles.get(storeId)) {
      case (?storeProfile) {
        switch (storeProfile.mode) {
          case (#stock) {
            Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Stock stores cannot access AI assistant endpoints");
          };
          case (#golden) {
            let knowledgeBase = storeProfile.assistantKnowledge;
            let mostRelevant = findMostRelevantAnswer(knowledgeBase, question);

            switch (mostRelevant) {
              case (?answer) { answer };
              case (null) { getFallbackResponse(question) };
            };
          };
        };
      };
      case (null) { "Afsuski, ko'rsatilgan identifikator bo'yicha do'kon topilmadi." };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func createChatThread(storeId : Principal, productId : Text) : async Text {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can create chat threads");
    };

    if (not storeProfiles.containsKey(storeId)) {
      Runtime.trap("Store does not exist");
    };

    switch (products.get(productId)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Product does not exist") };
      case (?product) {
        if (product.storeId != storeId.toText()) {
          Runtime.trap("Product does not belong to the specified store");
        };
      };
    };

    let threadId = caller.toText() # "_" # storeId.toText() # "_" # productId;

    if (chatThreads.containsKey(threadId)) {
      return threadId;
    };

    let newThread : ChatThread = {
      id = threadId;
      buyer = caller;
      store = storeId;
      productId;
      messages = List.empty<ChatMessage>();
      status = #ongoing;
      lastUpdate = Time.now();
    };
    chatThreads.add(threadId, newThread);

    let notification : Notification = {
      id = Time.now().toText();
      recipient = storeId;
      message = "A customer is interested in your product";
      timestamp = Time.now();
      notificationType = #newChatStarted;
      isRead = false;
    };

    switch (notifications.get(storeId)) {
      case (?existingList) {
        existingList.add(notification);
      };
      case (null) {
        let newList = List.empty<Notification>();
        newList.add(notification);
        notifications.add(storeId, newList);
      };
    };

    threadId;
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func sendChatMessage(threadId : Text, content : Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can send messages");
    };

    switch (chatThreads.get(threadId)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Chat thread does not exist") };
      case (?thread) {
        if (caller != thread.buyer and caller != thread.store) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: You are not a participant in this chat");
        };

        let messageId = threadId # "_" # Time.now().toText();
        let newMessage : ChatMessage = {
          id = messageId;
          sender = caller;
          content = content;
          timestamp = Time.now();
        };

        thread.messages.add(newMessage);
        let updatedThread = {
          thread with
          messages = thread.messages;
          lastUpdate = Time.now();
        };
        chatThreads.add(threadId, updatedThread);
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func endChatThread(threadId : Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can end chat threads");
    };

    switch (chatThreads.get(threadId)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Chat thread does not exist") };
      case (?thread) {
        if (caller != thread.buyer and caller != thread.store) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: You are not a participant in this chat");
        };

        let updatedThread = {
          thread with
          status = #ended(Time.now());
        };

        chatThreads.add(threadId, updatedThread);
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func requestHumanSeller(threadId : Text, additionalMessage : ?Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can request a human seller");
    };

    switch (chatThreads.get(threadId)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Chat thread does not exist") };
      case (?thread) {
        if (caller != thread.buyer) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only the buyer can request a human seller for this chat");
        };

        let notification : Notification = {
          id = Time.now().toText();
          recipient = thread.store;
          message = "A customer has requested human assistance for chat thread: " # threadId;
          timestamp = Time.now();
          notificationType = #humanSellerRequested(additionalMessage);
          isRead = false;
        };

        switch (notifications.get(thread.store)) {
          case (?existingList) {
            existingList.add(notification);
          };
          case (null) {
            let newList = List.empty<Notification>();
            newList.add(notification);
            notifications.add(thread.store, newList);
          };
        };
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func sellerTakeoverChat(threadId : Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can take over chat threads");
    };

    switch (chatThreads.get(threadId)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Chat thread does not exist") };
      case (?thread) {
        if (caller != thread.store) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only the seller can take over this chat");
        };

        let systemMessage : ChatMessage = {
          id = "system_message_" # Time.now().toText();
          sender = caller;
          content = "The store seller has taken over. You are now chatting with a human, not AI.";
          timestamp = Time.now();
        };

        thread.messages.add(systemMessage);
        let updatedThread = {
          thread with
          messages = thread.messages;
          status = #takenOver { takeoverTime = Time.now() };
          lastUpdate = Time.now();
        };
        chatThreads.add(threadId, updatedThread);
      };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getChatThread(threadId : Text) : async ?{
    id : Text;
    buyer : Principal;
    store : Principal;
    productId : Text;
    messages : [ChatMessage];
    status : ChatStatus;
  } {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access chat threads");
    };

    switch (chatThreads.get(threadId)) {
      case (null) { null };
      case (?thread) {
        if (caller != thread.buyer and caller != thread.store) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: You are not a participant in this chat");
        };
        ?{
          id = thread.id;
          buyer = thread.buyer;
          store = thread.store;
          productId = thread.productId;
          messages = thread.messages.toArray();
          status = thread.status;
        };
      };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getUserChatThreads() : async [{
    id : Text;
    buyer : Principal;
    store : Principal;
    productId : Text;
    messages : [ChatMessage];
    status : ChatStatus;
    lastUpdate : Int;
  }] {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access chat threads");
    };

    let filteredThreads = chatThreads.values().toArray().filter(
      func(thread) { thread.buyer == caller or thread.store == caller },
    );

    filteredThreads.map(
      func(thread) {
        {
          id = thread.id;
          buyer = thread.buyer;
          store = thread.store;
          productId = thread.productId;
          messages = thread.messages.toArray();
          status = thread.status;
          lastUpdate = thread.lastUpdate;
        };
      }
    );
  };

  public query func getStoreProfile(storeId : Principal) : async ?StoreProfile {
    storeProfiles.get(storeId);
  };

  public query func getStoreProducts(storeId : Principal) : async [Product] {
    products.values().toArray().filter<Product>(
      func(p) { p.storeId == storeId.toText() },
    );
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func becomeSeller(activationData : StoreProfile) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can become sellers");
    };

    let hasConsent = switch (userConsents.get(caller)) {
      case (null) { false };
      case (?record) {
        switch (record.sellerOnboarding) {
          case (#accepted _) { true };
          case (#notAccepted) { false };
        };
      };
    };

    if (not hasConsent) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Seller onboarding consent must be accepted before becoming a seller");
    };

    if (storeProfiles.containsKey(caller)) {
      Runtime.trap("Store already exists");
    };

    if (activationData.owner != caller) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Cannot create store for another user");
    };

    let validProfile : StoreProfile = {
      activationData with
      media = validateStoreMedia(activationData.media);
      mode = #stock;
    };

    storeProfiles.add(caller, validProfile);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func updateStoreProfile(store : StoreProfile) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can update store profiles");
    };

    if (store.owner != caller) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only update your own store");
    };

    if (not storeProfiles.containsKey(caller)) {
      Runtime.trap("Store does not exist");
    };

    let validMedia = validateStoreMedia(store.media);
    let storeWithValidMedia = { store with media = validMedia };

    storeProfiles.add(caller, storeWithValidMedia);
  };

  func validateStoreMedia(media : StoreMedia) : StoreMedia {
    let maxImages = 10;
    let storeImages = if (media.storeImages.size() > maxImages) {
      let storeImagesArray = media.storeImages;
      let tempImages = List.empty<StoreImage>();

      var index = 0;
      for (image in storeImagesArray.values()) {
        if (index < maxImages) {
          tempImages.add(image);
        };
        index += 1;
      };
      tempImages.toArray();
    } else {
      media.storeImages;
    };

    {
      media with
      storeImages
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func addStoreProduct(product : Product) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can add products");
    };

    switch (storeProfiles.get(caller)) {
      case (null) {
        Runtime.trap("You must be a seller to add products");
      };
      case (?storeProfile) {
        if (product.storeId != caller.toText()) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only add products to your own store");
        };

        switch (storeProfile.mode) {
          case (#stock) {
            let productCount = products.values().toArray().filter(
              func(p) { p.storeId == caller.toText() },
            ).size();
            if (productCount >= 10) {
              Runtime.trap("Stock stores cannot add more than 10 products");
            };
          };
          case (#golden) {};
        };
      };
    };

    products.add(product.id, product);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func updateStoreProduct(product : Product) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can update products");
    };

    if (product.storeId != caller.toText()) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only update products in your own store");
    };

    switch (products.get(product.id)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Product does not exist") };
      case (?existingProduct) {
        if (existingProduct.storeId != caller.toText()) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only update your own products");
        };
        products.add(product.id, product);
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func deleteStoreProduct(productId : Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can delete products");
    };

    switch (products.get(productId)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Product does not exist") };
      case (?product) {
        if (product.storeId != caller.toText()) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only delete your own products");
        };
        products.remove(productId);
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func editProductFields(productId : Text, fields : EditableProductFields) : async Product {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can edit products");
    };

    switch (products.get(productId)) {
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("Product does not exist") };
      case (?product) {
        if (product.storeId != caller.toText()) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only edit your own products");
        };

        if (fields.id != productId) {
          Runtime.trap("Product ID mismatch");
        };

        let updatedProduct = {
          product with
          name = fields.name;
          description = fields.description;
          price = fields.price;
        };

        products.add(productId, updatedProduct);
        updatedProduct;
      };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getMyStoreProfile() : async ?StoreProfile {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access store profiles");
    };

    storeProfiles.get(caller);
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getMyStoreProducts() : async [Product] {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access store products");
    };

    products.values().toArray().filter<Product>(
      func(p) { p.storeId == caller.toText() },
    );
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func markNotificationAsRead(notificationId : Text) : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can mark notifications as read");
    };

    switch (notifications.get(caller)) {
      case (?list) {
        let notificationExists = list.toArray().filter(func(n) { n.id == notificationId and n.recipient == caller }).size() > 0;

        if (not notificationExists) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Notification does not belong to caller");
        };

        let updatedList = list.map<Notification, Notification>(
          func(n) {
            if (n.id == notificationId) {
              { n with isRead = true };
            } else { n };
          }
        );
        notifications.add(caller, updatedList);
      };
      case (null) { Runtime.trap("No notifications for caller") };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getUnreadNotifications() : async [Notification] {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access notifications");
    };

    switch (notifications.get(caller)) {
      case (?list) {
        list.toArray().filter(func(n) { not n.isRead and n.recipient == caller });
      };
      case (null) { [] };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getAllNotifications() : async [Notification] {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access notifications");
    };

    switch (notifications.get(caller)) {
      case (?list) {
        list.toArray().filter(func(n) { n.recipient == caller });
      };
      case (null) { [] };
    };
  };

  func cleanupExpiredData() : async () {
    let now = Time.now();
    let dayInNanos : Int = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000;
    let sevenDays : Int = 7 * dayInNanos;

    for ((id, chat) in chatThreads.clone().entries()) {
      let messagesList = chat.messages.toArray();
      if (messagesList.size() > 0) {
        let mostRecentMessage = messagesList[messagesList.size() - 1];
        switch (chat.status) {
          case (#ended(_)) {
            if (now - mostRecentMessage.timestamp > sevenDays) {
              chatThreads.remove(id);
            };
          };
          case (_) {};
        };
      } else {
        chatThreads.remove(id);
      };
    };
  };

  ignore Timer.recurringTimer<system>(
    #nanoseconds(24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000),
    cleanupExpiredData,
  );

  func checkUserAccess(caller : Principal) {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can access this function");
    };
  };

  func registerOrGetSet(caller : Principal, map : Map.Map<Principal, Set.Set<Text>>) : Set.Set<Text> {
    switch (map.get(caller)) {
      case (null) {
        let newSet = Set.empty<Text>();
        map.add(caller, newSet);
        newSet;
      };
      case (?set) { set };
    };
  };

  public type _InternalState = ();
  public query ({ caller }) func _heart() : async ?_InternalState {
    null;
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getStoreMode(storeId : Principal) : async ?StoreMode {
    switch (storeProfiles.get(storeId)) {
      case (null) { null };
      case (?storeProfile) { ?storeProfile.mode };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func toggleStoreMode(targetStoreId : Principal) : async StoreMode {
    if (not (AccessControl.isAdmin(accessControlState, caller))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only administrators can change store modes");
    };

    switch (storeProfiles.get(targetStoreId)) {
      case (null) {
        Runtime.trap("No store profile found for the specified store");
      };
      case (?storeProfile) {
        let newMode = switch (storeProfile.mode) {
          case (#stock) { #golden };
          case (#golden) { #stock };
        };

        let updatedProfile : StoreProfile = {
          storeProfile with
          mode = newMode;
        };

        storeProfiles.add(targetStoreId, updatedProfile);
        newMode;
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func createProductWithPricing(productInput : Product, storeMode : StoreMode, hasInstagramDiscount : Bool) : async Product {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can create products");
    };

    if (productInput.storeId != caller.toText()) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only create products for your own store");
    };

    switch (storeProfiles.get(caller)) {
      case (null) {
        Runtime.trap("You must be a seller to create products");
      };
      case (?storeProfile) {
        if (storeProfile.mode != storeMode) {
          Runtime.trap("Store mode mismatch: provided mode does not match actual store mode");
        };
      };
    };

    let now = Time.now();
    var tier : ProductTier = #stockProduct;
    var monthlyPrice = 0;

    switch (storeMode) {
      case (#stock) {
        tier := #stockProduct;
      };
      case (#golden) {
        tier := if (hasInstagramDiscount) { #goldenInstagramTagged } else {
          #goldenRegular;
        };
        monthlyPrice := if (hasInstagramDiscount) { 400 } else { 800 };
      };
    };

    let product : Product = {
      productInput with
      tier = tier;
      monthlyPrice;
    };

    await addStoreProduct(product);
    product;
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getProductPricing(storeId : Principal, productId : Text) : async ?(ProductTier, Nat) {
    switch (products.get(productId)) {
      case (null) { null };
      case (?product) {
        ?(product.tier, product.monthlyPrice);
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func upgradeToGolden() : async () {
    if (not (AccessControl.hasPermission(accessControlState, caller, #user))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only users can upgrade stores");
    };

    switch (storeProfiles.get(caller)) {
      case (null) {
        Runtime.trap("Not Found: No store profile found for caller");
      };
      case (?storeProfile) {
        if (storeProfile.owner != caller) {
          Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Can only upgrade your own store");
        };

        switch (storeProfile.mode) {
          case (#golden) {
            Runtime.trap("Store already has golden membership");
          };
          case (#stock) {
            let updatedProfile : StoreProfile = {
              storeProfile with
              mode = #golden;
            };
            storeProfiles.add(caller, updatedProfile);
          };
        };
      };
    };
  };
};

import Nat "mo:core/Nat";
import Principal "mo:core/Principal";
import Map "mo:core/Map";
import Array "mo:core/Array";
import Text "mo:core/Text";
import Time "mo:core/Time";
import Storage "Storage";
import Prim "mo:prim";
import Runtime "mo:core/Runtime";

mixin() {
  type ExternalBlob = Storage.ExternalBlob;

  transient let _caffeineStorageState : Storage.State = Storage.new();

  type _CaffeineStorageRefillInformation = {
    proposed_top_up_amount : ?Nat;
  };

  type _CaffeineStorageRefillResult = {
    success : ?Bool;
    topped_up_amount : ?Nat;
  };

  type _CaffeineStorageCreateCertificateResult = {
    method : Text;
    blob_hash : Text;
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func _caffeineStorageRefillCashier(refillInformation : ?_CaffeineStorageRefillInformation) : async _CaffeineStorageRefillResult {
    let cashier = await Storage.getCashierPrincipal();
    if (cashier != caller) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized access");
    };
    await Storage.refillCashier(_caffeineStorageState, cashier, refillInformation);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func _caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals() : async () {
    await Storage.updateGatewayPrincipals(_caffeineStorageState);
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func _caffeineStorageBlobIsLive(hash : Blob) : async Bool {
    Prim.isStorageBlobLive(hash);
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func _caffeineStorageBlobsToDelete() : async [Blob] {
    if (not Storage.isAuthorized(_caffeineStorageState, caller)) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized access");
    };
    let deadBlobs = Prim.getDeadBlobs();
    switch (deadBlobs) {
      case (null) {
        [];
      };
      case (?deadBlobs) {
        deadBlobs.sliceToArray(0, 10000);
      };
    };
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func _caffeineStorageConfirmBlobDeletion(blobs : [Blob]) : async () {
    if (not Storage.isAuthorized(_caffeineStorageState, caller)) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized access");
    };
    Prim.pruneConfirmedDeadBlobs(blobs);
    // Trigger GC forcefully.
    type GC = actor {
      __motoko_gc_trigger : () -> async ();
    };
    let myGC = actor (debug_show (Prim.getSelfPrincipal<system>())) : GC;
    await myGC.__motoko_gc_trigger();
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func _caffeineStorageCreateCertificate(blobHash : Text) : async _CaffeineStorageCreateCertificateResult {
    {
      method = "upload";
      blob_hash = blobHash;
    };
  };
};

import Runtime "mo:core/Runtime";
import Principal "mo:core/Principal";
import Array "mo:core/Array";
import Prim "mo:prim";
import Cycles "mo:core/Cycles";
import Nat "mo:core/Nat";

module {
  public type ExternalBlob = Blob;

  public type State = {
    var authorizedPrincipals : [Principal];
  };

  public func new() : State {
    let authorizedPrincipals : [Principal] = [];
    {
      var authorizedPrincipals;
    };
  };

  public func getCashierPrincipal() : async Principal {
    switch (Prim.envVar<system>("CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL")) {
      case (null) {
        Runtime.trap("CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL environment variable is not set");
      };
      case (?cashierPrincipal) {
        Principal.fromText(cashierPrincipal);
      };
    };
  };

  // Authorization functions
  public func updateGatewayPrincipals(registry : State) : async () {
    let cashierPrincipal = await getCashierPrincipal();
    let cashierActor = actor (cashierPrincipal.toText()) : actor {
      storage_gateway_principal_list_v1 : () -> async [Principal];
    };

    registry.authorizedPrincipals := await cashierActor.storage_gateway_principal_list_v1();
  };

  public func isAuthorized(registry : State, caller : Principal) : Bool {
    let authorized = registry.authorizedPrincipals.find(
      func(principal) {
        Principal.equal(principal, caller);
      }
    ) != null;
    authorized;
  };

  public func refillCashier(
    _registry : State,
    cashier : Principal,
    refillInformation : ?{
      proposed_top_up_amount : ?Nat;
    }
  ) : async {
    success : ?Bool;
    topped_up_amount : ?Nat;
  } {
    let currentBalance = Cycles.balance();
    let reservedCycles : Nat = 400_000_000_000;

    let currentFreeCyclesCount : Nat = Nat.sub(currentBalance, reservedCycles);

    let cyclesToSend : Nat = switch (refillInformation) {
      case (null) { currentFreeCyclesCount };
      case (?info) {
        switch (info.proposed_top_up_amount) {
          case (null) { currentFreeCyclesCount };
          case (?proposed) { Nat.min(proposed, currentFreeCyclesCount) };
        };
      };
    };

    let targetCanister = actor (cashier.toText()) : actor {
      account_top_up_v1 : ({ account : Principal }) -> async ();
    };

    await (with cycles = cyclesToSend) targetCanister.account_top_up_v1({ account = Prim.getSelfPrincipal<system>() });

    {
      success = ?true;
      topped_up_amount = ?cyclesToSend;
    };
  };
};

import Map "mo:core/Map";
import Principal "mo:core/Principal";
import Runtime "mo:core/Runtime";

module {
  public type UserRole = {
    #admin;
    #user;
    #guest;
  };

  public type AccessControlState = {
    var adminAssigned : Bool;
    userRoles : Map.Map<Principal, UserRole>;
  };

  public func initState() : AccessControlState {
    {
      var adminAssigned = false;
      userRoles = Map.empty<Principal, UserRole>();
    };
  };

  // First principal that calls this function becomes admin, all other principals become users.
  public func initialize(state : AccessControlState, caller : Principal, adminToken : Text, userProvidedToken : Text) {
    if (caller.isAnonymous()) { return };
    switch (state.userRoles.get(caller)) {
      case (?_) {};
      case (null) {
        if (not state.adminAssigned and userProvidedToken == adminToken) {
          state.userRoles.add(caller, #admin);
          state.adminAssigned := true;
        } else {
          state.userRoles.add(caller, #user);
        };
      };
    };
  };

  public func getUserRole(state : AccessControlState, caller : Principal) : UserRole {
    if (caller.isAnonymous()) { return #guest };
    switch (state.userRoles.get(caller)) {
      case (?role) { role };
      case (null) {
        Runtime.trap("User is not registered");
      };
    };
  };

  public func assignRole(state : AccessControlState, caller : Principal, user : Principal, role : UserRole) {
    if (not (isAdmin(state, caller))) {
      Runtime.trap("Unauthorized: Only admins can assign user roles");
    };
    state.userRoles.add(user, role);
  };

  public func hasPermission(state : AccessControlState, caller : Principal, requiredRole : UserRole) : Bool {
    let userRole = getUserRole(state, caller);
    if (userRole == #admin or requiredRole == #guest) { true } else { userRole == requiredRole };
  };

  public func isAdmin(state : AccessControlState, caller : Principal) : Bool {
    getUserRole(state, caller) == #admin;
  };
};

import AccessControl "./access-control";
import Prim "mo:prim";
import Runtime "mo:core/Runtime";

mixin(accessControlState : AccessControl.AccessControlState) {
  // Initialize auth (first caller becomes admin, others become users)
  public shared ({ caller }) func _initializeAccessControlWithSecret(userSecret : Text) : async () {
    switch (Prim.envVar<system>("CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN")) {
      case (null) {
        Runtime.trap("CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable is not set");
      };
      case (?adminToken) {
        AccessControl.initialize(accessControlState, caller, adminToken, userSecret);
      };
    };
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func getCallerUserRole() : async AccessControl.UserRole {
    AccessControl.getUserRole(accessControlState, caller);
  };

  public shared ({ caller }) func assignCallerUserRole(user : Principal, role : AccessControl.UserRole) : async () {
    // Admin-only check happens inside
    AccessControl.assignRole(accessControlState, caller, user, role);
  };

  public query ({ caller }) func isCallerAdmin() : async Bool {
    AccessControl.isAdmin(accessControlState, caller);
  };
};

import { createActor, type backendInterface, type CreateActorOptions, ExternalBlob } from './backend';
import { StorageClient } from './utils/StorageClient';
import { HttpAgent } from '@icp-sdk/core/agent';

const DEFAULT_STORAGE_GATEWAY_URL = 'https://blob.caffeine.ai';
const DEFAULT_BUCKET_NAME = 'default-bucket';
const DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID = '0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000';

interface JsonConfig {
    backend_host: string;
    backend_canister_id: string;
    project_id: string;
    ii_derivation_origin: string;
}

interface Config {
    backend_host?: string;
    backend_canister_id: string;
    storage_gateway_url: string;
    bucket_name: string;
    project_id: string;
    ii_derivation_origin?: string;
}

let configCache: Config | null = null;

export async function loadConfig(): Promise<Config> {
    if (configCache) {
        return configCache;
    }
    const backendCanisterId = process.env.CANISTER_ID_BACKEND;
    const envBaseUrl = process.env.BASE_URL || '/';
    const baseUrl = envBaseUrl.endsWith('/') ? envBaseUrl : `${envBaseUrl}/`;
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}env.json`);
        const config = (await response.json()) as JsonConfig;
        if (!backendCanisterId && config.backend_canister_id === 'undefined') {
            console.error('CANISTER_ID_BACKEND is not set');
            throw new Error('CANISTER_ID_BACKEND is not set');
        }

        const fullConfig = {
            backend_host: config.backend_host == 'undefined' ? undefined : config.backend_host,
            backend_canister_id: (config.backend_canister_id == 'undefined'
                ? backendCanisterId
                : config.backend_canister_id) as string,
            storage_gateway_url: process.env.STORAGE_GATEWAY_URL ?? 'nogateway',
            bucket_name: DEFAULT_BUCKET_NAME,
            project_id: config.project_id !== 'undefined' ? config.project_id : DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID,
            ii_derivation_origin: config.ii_derivation_origin == 'undefined' ? undefined : config.ii_derivation_origin
        };
        configCache = fullConfig;
        return fullConfig;
    } catch {
        if (!backendCanisterId) {
            console.error('CANISTER_ID_BACKEND is not set');
            throw new Error('CANISTER_ID_BACKEND is not set');
        }
        const fallbackConfig = {
            backend_host: undefined,
            backend_canister_id: backendCanisterId,
            storage_gateway_url: DEFAULT_STORAGE_GATEWAY_URL,
            bucket_name: DEFAULT_BUCKET_NAME,
            project_id: DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID,
            ii_derivation_origin: undefined
        };
        return fallbackConfig;
    }
}

function extractAgentErrorMessage(error: string): string {
    const errorString = String(error);
    const match = errorString.match(/with message:\s*'([^'].+)'\./s);
    return match ? match[1] : errorString;
}

function processError(e: unknown): never {
    if (e && typeof e === 'object' && 'message' in e) {
        throw new Error(extractAgentErrorMessage(e['message'] as string));
    } else throw e;
}

export async function createActorWithConfig(options?: CreateActorOptions): Promise<backendInterface> {
    const config = await loadConfig();
    if (!options) {
        options = {};
    }
    const agent = new HttpAgent({
        ...options.agentOptions,
        host: config.backend_host
    });
    if (config.backend_host?.includes('localhost')) {
        await agent.fetchRootKey().catch((err) => {
            console.warn('Unable to fetch root key. Check to ensure that your local replica is running');
            console.error(err);
        });
    }
    options = {
        ...options,
        agent: agent,
        processError
    };

    const storageClient = new StorageClient(
        config.bucket_name,
        config.storage_gateway_url,
        config.backend_canister_id,
        config.project_id,
        agent
    );

    const MOTOKO_DEDUPLICATION_SENTINEL = '!caf!';

    const uploadFile = async (file: ExternalBlob): Promise<Uint8Array> => {
        const { hash } = await storageClient.putFile(await file.getBytes(), file.onProgress);
        return new TextEncoder().encode(MOTOKO_DEDUPLICATION_SENTINEL + hash);
    };

    const downloadFile = async (bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<ExternalBlob> => {
        const hashWithPrefix = new TextDecoder().decode(new Uint8Array(bytes));
        const hash = hashWithPrefix.substring(MOTOKO_DEDUPLICATION_SENTINEL.length);
        const url = await storageClient.getDirectURL(hash);
        return ExternalBlob.fromURL(url);
    };

    return createActor(config.backend_canister_id, uploadFile, downloadFile, options);
}

import { RouterProvider, createRouter, createRoute, createRootRoute, Outlet } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useInternetIdentity } from './hooks/useInternetIdentity';
import { ThemeProvider } from './components/theme/ThemeProvider';
import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/sonner';
import AuthGate from './components/auth/AuthGate';
import FirstVisitConsentGate from './components/legal/FirstVisitConsentGate';
import BottomTabsLayout from './layouts/BottomTabsLayout';
import ProductsPage from './pages/ProductsPage';
import ChatsPage from './pages/ChatsPage';
import SavedPage from './pages/SavedPage';
import MyProfilePage from './pages/MyProfilePage';
import MyStorePage from './pages/MyStorePage';
import MyStoreMessagesPage from './pages/MyStoreMessagesPage';
import ProductDetailPage from './pages/ProductDetailPage';
import ProductCommentsPage from './pages/ProductCommentsPage';
import StoreProfilePage from './pages/StoreProfilePage';
import ChatThreadPage from './pages/ChatThreadPage';
import ProfileLikesPage from './pages/ProfileLikesPage';
import ProfileCommentsPage from './pages/ProfileCommentsPage';
import ProfileSubscriptionsPage from './pages/ProfileSubscriptionsPage';

const rootRoute = createRootRoute({
  component: () => (
    <ThemeProvider attribute="class" defaultTheme="dark" enableSystem={false}>
      <AuthGate>
        <FirstVisitConsentGate>
          <Outlet />
        </FirstVisitConsentGate>
      </AuthGate>
      <Toaster />
    </ThemeProvider>
  ),
});

const layoutRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  id: 'layout',
  component: BottomTabsLayout,
});

const productsRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => layoutRoute,
  path: '/',
  component: ProductsPage,
});

const chatsRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => layoutRoute,
  path: '/chats',
  component: ChatsPage,
});

const savedRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => layoutRoute,
  path: '/saved',
  component: SavedPage,
});

const profileRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => layoutRoute,
  path: '/profile',
  component: MyProfilePage,
});

const storeRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => layoutRoute,
  path: '/my-store',
  component: MyStorePage,
});

const productDetailRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/product/$productId',
  component: ProductDetailPage,
});

const productCommentsRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/product/$productId/comments',
  component: ProductCommentsPage,
});

const storeProfileRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/store/$storeId',
  component: StoreProfilePage,
});

const chatThreadRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/chat/$threadId',
  component: ChatThreadPage,
});

const myStoreMessagesRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/my-store/messages',
  component: MyStoreMessagesPage,
});

const profileLikesRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/profile/likes',
  component: ProfileLikesPage,
});

const profileCommentsRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/profile/comments',
  component: ProfileCommentsPage,
});

const profileSubscriptionsRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/profile/subscriptions',
  component: ProfileSubscriptionsPage,
});

const routeTree = rootRoute.addChildren([
  layoutRoute.addChildren([
    productsRoute,
    chatsRoute,
    savedRoute,
    profileRoute,
    storeRoute,
  ]),
  productDetailRoute,
  productCommentsRoute,
  storeProfileRoute,
  chatThreadRoute,
  myStoreMessagesRoute,
  profileLikesRoute,
  profileCommentsRoute,
  profileSubscriptionsRoute,
]);

const router = createRouter({ routeTree });

declare module '@tanstack/react-router' {
  interface Register {
    router: typeof router;
  }
}

export default function App() {
  return <RouterProvider router={router} />;
}

}
export function createActor(canisterId: string, _uploadFile: (file: ExternalBlob) => Promise<Uint8Array>, _downloadFile: (file: Uint8Array) => Promise<ExternalBlob>, options: CreateActorOptions = {}): Backend {
    const agent = options.agent || HttpAgent.createSync({
        ...options.agentOptions
    });
    if (options.agent && options.agentOptions) {
        console.warn("Detected both agent and agentOptions passed to createActor. Ignoring agentOptions and proceeding with the provided agent.");
    }
    const actor = Actor.createActor<_SERVICE>(idlFactory, {
        agent,
        canisterId: canisterId,
        ...options.actorOptions
    });
    return new Backend(actor, _uploadFile, _downloadFile, options.processError);
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/legal/FirstVisitConsentGate.tsx
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useInternetIdentity } from '../../hooks/useInternetIdentity';
import { useCheckConsent, useAcceptConsent } from '../../hooks/useConsent';
import { ConsentType } from '../../backend';
import ConsentModal from './ConsentModal';

interface FirstVisitConsentGateProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export default function FirstVisitConsentGate({ children }: FirstVisitConsentGateProps) {
  const { identity } = useInternetIdentity();
  const { data: hasConsent, isLoading: isCheckingConsent, isFetched } = useCheckConsent(ConsentType.firstVisit);
  const { mutate: acceptConsent, isPending: isAccepting } = useAcceptConsent();
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (identity && isFetched && hasConsent === false) {
      setShowModal(true);
    }
  }, [identity, hasConsent, isFetched]);

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    acceptConsent(
      { 
        consentType: ConsentType.firstVisit, 
        acceptanceData: new Date().toISOString() 
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          setShowModal(false);
        },
      }
    );
  };

  if (!identity || isCheckingConsent) {
    return <>{children}</>;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {children}
      <ConsentModal 
        open={showModal} 
        onConfirm={handleConfirm}
        isLoading={isAccepting}
      />
    </>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';

interface ConsentModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export default function ConsentModal({ open, onConfirm, isLoading }: ConsentModalProps) {
  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);
  const { t } = useI18n();

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (isChecked) {
      onConfirm();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={() => {}}>
      <DialogContent 
        className="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm max-w-2xl max-h-[85vh] border border-yellow-500/40"
        onPointerDownOutside={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        onEscapeKeyDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      >
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="text-2xl font-bold gold-text text-center mb-2">
            {t('legal.heading')}
          </DialogTitle>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center italic">
            {t('legal.pleaseRead')}
          </p>
        </DialogHeader>
        
        <ScrollArea className="h-[50vh] pr-4">
          <div className="space-y-4 text-foreground leading-relaxed">
            <p className="text-base whitespace-pre-line">{t('legal.disclaimerText')}</p>
          </div>
        </ScrollArea>

        <DialogFooter className="flex-col space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-start space-x-3 w-full">
            <Checkbox 
              id="consent-checkbox" 
              checked={isChecked}
              onCheckedChange={(checked) => setIsChecked(checked === true)}
              className="mt-1"
            />
            <Label 
              htmlFor="consent-checkbox" 
              className="text-sm leading-relaxed cursor-pointer flex-1"
            >
              {t('legal.checkboxLabel')}
            </Label>
          </div>
          
          <Button
            onClick={handleConfirm}
            disabled={!isChecked || isLoading}
            className="gold-button w-full"
          >
            {isLoading ? t('common.saving') : t('legal.confirmButton')}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}


================================================================================
FILE: frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton.tsx
================================================================================

import React from 'react';
import { useInternetIdentity } from '../../hooks/useInternetIdentity';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';

export default function LoginButton() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { login, clear, loginStatus, identity } = useInternetIdentity();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const isAuthenticated = !!identity;
  const disabled = loginStatus === 'logging-in';
  const text = loginStatus === 'logging-in' ? t('auth.loggingIn') : isAuthenticated ? t('auth.logout') : t('auth.login');

  const handleAuth = async () => {
    if (isAuthenticated) {
      await clear();
      queryClient.clear();
    } else {
      try {
        await login();
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error('Login error:', error);
        if (error.message === 'User is already authenticated') {
          await clear();
          setTimeout(() => login(), 300);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <Button
      onClick={handleAuth}
      disabled={disabled}
      className="w-full gold-button"
      size="lg"
    >
      {text}
    </Button>
  );
}

import { useInternetIdentity } from '../../hooks/useInternetIdentity';
import LoginButton from './LoginButton';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { BRANDING } from '../../config/branding';

export default function AuthGate({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { identity, isInitializing } = useInternetIdentity();
  const { t } = useI18n();

  const isAuthenticated = !!identity && !identity.getPrincipal().isAnonymous();

  if (isInitializing) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen items-center justify-center bg-background">
        <div className="text-center">
          <img 
            src={BRANDING.logo.large}
            alt={BRANDING.platformName}
            className="w-32 h-32 mx-auto mb-4 object-contain"
          />
          <div className="text-muted-foreground">{t('common.loading')}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen items-center justify-center bg-background">
        <div className="text-center space-y-6">
          <div className="mb-8">
            <img 
              src={BRANDING.logo.large}
              alt={BRANDING.platformName}
              className="w-40 h-40 mx-auto mb-6 object-contain"
            />
            <h1 className="text-4xl brand-name-elegant mb-4">
              {BRANDING.platformName}
            </h1>
            <div className="text-lg text-muted-foreground">{t('auth.subtitle')}</div>
          </div>
          <LoginButton />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/chat/AssistantChatPanel.tsx
================================================================================

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useCreateChatThread, useSendChatMessage, useGetStoreAssistantOutput, useRequestHumanSeller } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import { Principal } from '@dfinity/principal';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Send, User } from 'lucide-react';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface AssistantChatPanelProps {
  storeId: string;
  productId: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  mode?: 'product' | 'store';
  hideTitle?: boolean;
}

interface ConversationItem {
  question: string;
  answer: string;
}

export default function AssistantChatPanel({ 
  storeId, 
  productId, 
  placeholder,
  mode = 'product',
  hideTitle = false
}: AssistantChatPanelProps) {
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState('');
  const [conversationHistory, setConversationHistory] = useState<ConversationItem[]>([]);
  const [currentThreadId, setCurrentThreadId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { t } = useI18n();
  
  const { mutate: getStoreAssistant, data: answer, isPending: isFetching } = useGetStoreAssistantOutput();
  const { mutate: createThread } = useCreateChatThread();
  const { mutate: sendMessage } = useSendChatMessage();
  const { mutate: requestHuman } = useRequestHumanSeller();

  const defaultPlaceholder = mode === 'product' 
    ? t('assistant.productPlaceholder')
    : t('assistant.placeholder');

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!question.trim()) return;

    const currentQuestion = question.trim();
    setQuestion('');

    // Get AI response
    getStoreAssistant(
      { storeId: Principal.fromText(storeId), question: currentQuestion },
      {
        onSuccess: (response) => {
          setConversationHistory(prev => [
            ...prev,
            { question: currentQuestion, answer: response }
          ]);
        },
        onError: (error: any) => {
          toast.error(t('assistant.genericError') + ': ' + error.message);
        }
      }
    );

    // Only create thread for product mode
    if (mode === 'product' && productId) {
      try {
        createThread(
          { storeId: Principal.fromText(storeId), productId },
          {
            onSuccess: (threadId) => {
              setCurrentThreadId(threadId);
              sendMessage({ threadId, content: currentQuestion });
            },
            onError: (error: any) => {
              toast.error(t('assistant.createChatError') + ': ' + error.message);
            }
          }
        );
      } catch (error: any) {
        toast.error(t('assistant.genericError') + ': ' + error.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleRequestHuman = () => {
    if (!currentThreadId) {
      toast.error(t('assistant.noActiveConversation'));
      return;
    }

    requestHuman(
      { threadId: currentThreadId, message: null },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(t('assistant.sellerNotifiedSuccess'));
        },
        onError: (error: any) => {
          toast.error(t('assistant.requestHumanError') + ': ' + error.message);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="dark-label-surface p-4 space-y-3">
      {!hideTitle && (
        <div className="text-sm font-semibold gold-text">{t('assistant.title')}</div>
      )}
      
      {conversationHistory.length === 0 && (
        <div className="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg p-3 text-sm border border-[oklch(0.85_0.15_85)]">
          {t('assistant.greeting')}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-3 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
        {conversationHistory.map((item, index) => (
          <div key={index} className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <div className="max-w-[80%] bg-[oklch(0.85_0.15_85)]/60 backdrop-blur-sm border border-[oklch(0.85_0.15_85)] rounded-lg p-3 text-sm">
                {item.question}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-start">
              <div className="max-w-[80%] bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm border border-[oklch(0.85_0.15_85)] rounded-lg p-3 text-sm">
                {item.answer}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}

        {isFetching && (
          <div className="flex justify-start">
            <div className="max-w-[80%] bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm border border-[oklch(0.85_0.15_85)] rounded-lg p-3 text-sm">
              {t('common.loading')}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Input
          value={question}
          onChange={(e) => setQuestion(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={placeholder || defaultPlaceholder}
          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSend()}
          disabled={isFetching}
        />
        <Button onClick={handleSend} disabled={!question.trim() || isFetching} size="icon">
          <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
        </Button>
      </div>

      {mode === 'product' && currentThreadId && conversationHistory.length > 0 && (
        <Button
          onClick={handleRequestHuman}
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="w-full"
        >
          <User className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
          {t('assistant.talkToOwner')}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { Edit2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface DisplayNameEditorProps {
  currentName: string;
}

export default function DisplayNameEditor({ currentName }: DisplayNameEditorProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState(currentName);
  const { t } = useI18n();

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (name.trim()) {
      // Store name in localStorage as backend doesn't support user profiles
      localStorage.setItem('userDisplayName', name.trim());
      toast.success('Display name updated');
      setOpen(false);
      // Reload to reflect changes
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-2">
          <Edit2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          {t('profile.editName')}
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{t('profile.editName')}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={t('auth.namePlaceholder')}
          />
          <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!name.trim()} className="w-full gold-button">
            {t('store.save')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileActivitySections.tsx
================================================================================

import { useGetUserLikedProducts, useGetUserComments, useGetSubscribedStores } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { Heart, MessageSquare, Store } from 'lucide-react';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import ProfileActivityNavCard from './ProfileActivityNavCard';

export default function ProfileActivitySections() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: likedProducts, isLoading: likesLoading } = useGetUserLikedProducts();
  const { data: userComments, isLoading: commentsLoading } = useGetUserComments();
  const { data: subscribedStoreIds, isLoading: subscriptionsLoading } = useGetSubscribedStores();

  const getLikesSubtitle = () => {
    if (likesLoading) return 'Loading...';
    if (!likedProducts || likedProducts.length === 0) return 'No likes yet';
    return `${likedProducts.length} ${likedProducts.length === 1 ? 'product' : 'products'}`;
  };

  const getCommentsSubtitle = () => {
    if (commentsLoading) return 'Loading...';
    if (!userComments || userComments.length === 0) return 'No comments yet';
    return `${userComments.length} ${userComments.length === 1 ? 'comment' : 'comments'}`;
  };

  const getSubscriptionsSubtitle = () => {
    if (subscriptionsLoading) return 'Loading...';
    if (!subscribedStoreIds || subscribedStoreIds.length === 0) return 'No subscriptions yet';
    return `${subscribedStoreIds.length} ${subscribedStoreIds.length === 1 ? 'store' : 'stores'}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* My Likes - Navigate to full page */}
      <ProfileActivityNavCard
        icon={<Heart className="w-5 h-5 gold-icon" />}
        title={t('profile.myLikes')}
        subtitle={getLikesSubtitle()}
        onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/profile/likes' })}
      />

      {/* My Comments - Navigate to full page */}
      <ProfileActivityNavCard
        icon={<MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5 gold-icon" />}
        title={t('profile.myComments')}
        subtitle={getCommentsSubtitle()}
        onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/profile/comments' })}
      />

      {/* My Subscriptions - Navigate to full page */}
      <ProfileActivityNavCard
        icon={<Store className="w-5 h-5 gold-icon" />}
        title={t('profile.mySubscriptions')}
        subtitle={getSubscriptionsSubtitle()}
        onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/profile/subscriptions' })}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import type { StoreProfile } from '../../backend';

interface StoreAvatarProps {
  storeProfile: StoreProfile | null | undefined;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  className?: string;
}

export default function StoreAvatar({ storeProfile, size = 'md', className = '' }: StoreAvatarProps) {
  const sizeClasses = {
    sm: 'w-8 h-8 text-xs',
    md: 'w-10 h-10 text-sm',
    lg: 'w-16 h-16 text-xl',
  };

  const logoUrl = storeProfile?.media?.logoImage?.getDirectURL();
  const storeName = storeProfile?.name || 'Store';
  const fallbackLetter = storeName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <Avatar className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${className}`}>
      {logoUrl && (
        <AvatarImage 
          src={logoUrl} 
          alt={storeName}
          className="object-cover"
        />
      )}
      <AvatarFallback className="bg-gold/20 text-gold font-semibold">
        {fallbackLetter}
      </AvatarFallback>
    </Avatar>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useGetMyStoreProfile, useUpdateStoreProfile } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import { useStableObjectUrls } from '../../hooks/useStableObjectUrls';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { ExternalBlob } from '../../backend';
import { Sparkles, Upload, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { stopEventPropagation } from '../../utils/eventGuards';

export default function GoldenAssistantImageUpload() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { data: storeProfile } = useGetMyStoreProfile();
  const { mutate: updateProfile, isPending } = useUpdateStoreProfile();

  const [assistantKnowledge, setAssistantKnowledge] = useState('');
  const [selectedImages, setSelectedImages] = useState<File[]>([]);

  // Use stable object URLs for preview images
  const previewUrls = useStableObjectUrls(selectedImages);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (storeProfile) {
      setAssistantKnowledge(storeProfile.assistantKnowledge || '');
    }
  }, [storeProfile]);

  const handleImageSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (files.length > 10) {
      toast.error(t('store.maxImages'));
      return;
    }
    setSelectedImages(files);
  };

  const removeImage = (index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    stopEventPropagation(e);
    setSelectedImages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!storeProfile) {
      toast.error(t('store.profileNotFound'));
      return;
    }

    try {
      let knowledgeText = assistantKnowledge;

      // Process images if any are selected
      if (selectedImages.length > 0) {
        knowledgeText += '\n\n[Images uploaded for AI training]';
        // In a real implementation, you would process these images
        // For now, we just acknowledge them in the knowledge base
      }

      updateProfile(
        {
          ...storeProfile,
          assistantKnowledge: knowledgeText,
        },
        {
          onSuccess: () => {
            toast.success(t('store.assistantKnowledgeUpdated'));
            setSelectedImages([]);
          },
          onError: (error: any) => {
            toast.error(t('store.assistantKnowledgeError') + ': ' + error.message);
          },
        }
      );
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(t('store.assistantKnowledgeError') + ': ' + error.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
        <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-gold" />
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold glossy-yellow-text">{t('store.goldenAssistant')}</h3>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="assistant-knowledge">{t('store.assistantKnowledge')}</Label>
        <Textarea
          id="assistant-knowledge"
          value={assistantKnowledge}
          onChange={(e) => setAssistantKnowledge(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('store.assistantKnowledgePlaceholder')}
          rows={6}
          className="resize-none"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="assistant-images">{t('store.assistantImages')}</Label>
        <Input
          id="assistant-images"
          type="file"
          accept="image/*"
          multiple
          onChange={handleImageSelect}
        />
        {selectedImages.length > 0 && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-2">
            {selectedImages.map((file, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="relative aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
                <img
                  src={previewUrls[index]}
                  alt={`AI Training ${index + 1}`}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="destructive"
                  size="icon"
                  className="absolute top-1 right-1 h-6 w-6 touch-manipulation"
                  onClick={(e) => removeImage(index, e)}
                  onPointerDown={stopEventPropagation}
                  onTouchStart={stopEventPropagation}
                >
                  <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <Button
        onClick={handleSave}
        disabled={isPending}
        className="w-full border-2 border-yellow-500 bg-yellow-500/10 hover:bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-500 font-semibold ring-2 ring-yellow-400/50"
      >
        {isPending ? t('common.loading') : t('store.saveAssistantData')}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/store/StoreAssistantQA.tsx
================================================================================

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useGetStoreAssistantOutput } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import { Principal } from '@dfinity/principal';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Send } from 'lucide-react';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface StoreAssistantQAProps {
  storeId: string;
}

export default function StoreAssistantQA({ storeId }: StoreAssistantQAProps) {
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState('');
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { mutate: getStoreAssistant, data: answer, isPending: isFetching } = useGetStoreAssistantOutput();

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (!question.trim()) return;

    getStoreAssistant(
      { storeId: Principal.fromText(storeId), question: question.trim() },
      {
        onError: (error: any) => {
          toast.error(t('assistant.genericError') + ': ' + error.message);
        }
      }
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="dark-label-surface p-4 space-y-3">
      <div className="text-sm font-semibold gold-text">{t('assistant.title')}</div>
      
      {!answer && (
        <div className="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg p-3 text-sm border border-[oklch(0.85_0.15_85)]">
          {t('assistant.greeting')}
        </div>
      )}

      {answer && (
        <div className="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg p-3 text-sm border border-[oklch(0.85_0.15_85)]">
          {answer}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Input
          value={question}
          onChange={(e) => setQuestion(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('assistant.placeholder')}
          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSend()}
          disabled={isFetching}
        />
        <Button onClick={handleSend} disabled={!question.trim() || isFetching} size="icon">
          <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
