FILE: frontend/src/components/store/CreateProductDialog.tsx
================================================================================

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useCreateProductWithPricing } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import { useInternetIdentity } from '../../hooks/useInternetIdentity';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { ExternalBlob, StoreMode, ProductTier } from '../../backend';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { stopEventPropagation } from '../../utils/eventGuards';

interface CreateProductDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  storeMode: StoreMode;
}

export default function CreateProductDialog({ open, onOpenChange, storeMode }: CreateProductDialogProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { identity } = useInternetIdentity();
  const { mutate: createProduct, isPending } = useCreateProductWithPricing();

  const [productName, setProductName] = useState('');
  const [productDescription, setProductDescription] = useState('');
  const [productPrice, setProductPrice] = useState('');
  const [productImages, setProductImages] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [productVideo, setProductVideo] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setProductName('');
    setProductDescription('');
    setProductPrice('');
    setProductImages([]);
    setProductVideo(null);
    setUploadProgress(0);
  };

  const handleImageSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (files.length > 10) {
      toast.error(t('store.maxImages'));
      return;
    }
    setProductImages(files);
    setProductVideo(null); // Clear video if images selected
  };

  const handleVideoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      // Validate video duration
      const video = document.createElement('video');
      video.preload = 'metadata';
      
      video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
        if (video.duration > 30) {
          toast.error('Video 30 soniyadan oshmasligi kerak');
          return;
        }
        setProductVideo(file);
        setProductImages([]); // Clear images if video selected
      };
      
      video.onerror = () => {
        toast.error('Video faylini yuklashda xatolik');
      };
      
      video.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    }
  };

  const removeImage = (index: number, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    stopEventPropagation(e);
    setProductImages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const generateVideoThumbnail = async (videoFile: File): Promise<Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>> => {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const video = document.createElement('video');
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      
      video.preload = 'metadata';
      video.muted = true;
      video.playsInline = true;
      
      video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
        video.currentTime = 0.5;
      };
      
      video.onseeked = () => {
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          reject(new Error('Canvas context not available'));
          return;
        }
        
        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        
        canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
          if (blob) {
            blob.arrayBuffer().then((buffer) => {
              URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
              resolve(new Uint8Array(buffer as ArrayBuffer));
            }).catch(reject);
          } else {
            reject(new Error('Failed to generate thumbnail blob'));
          }
        }, 'image/jpeg', 0.8);
      };
      
      video.onerror = () => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
        reject(new Error('Failed to load video'));
      };
      
      video.src = URL.createObjectURL(videoFile);
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!identity) {
      toast.error(t('store.loginRequired'));
      return;
    }

    if (!productName.trim()) {
      toast.error(t('store.enterProductName'));
      return;
    }

    if (!productPrice.trim() || isNaN(Number(productPrice)) || Number(productPrice) < 0) {
      toast.error(t('store.enterValidPrice'));
      return;
    }

    if (productImages.length === 0 && !productVideo) {
      toast.error('Kamida bitta rasm yoki video tanlang');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setUploadProgress(0);
      const storeId = identity.getPrincipal().toText();
      const productId = `${storeId}_${Date.now()}`;

      let mainImageBlob: ExternalBlob;
      let imageCarouselBlobs: ExternalBlob[] = [];
      let videoBlob: ExternalBlob | undefined = undefined;

      // Upload images if present
      if (productImages.length > 0) {
        const totalImages = productImages.length;
        for (let i = 0; i < productImages.length; i++) {
          const imageBytes = await productImages[i].arrayBuffer();
          const blob = ExternalBlob.fromBytes(new Uint8Array(imageBytes as ArrayBuffer)).withUploadProgress((percentage) => {
            const overallProgress = ((i / totalImages) * 50) + (percentage / totalImages / 2);
            setUploadProgress(Math.round(overallProgress));
          });
          imageCarouselBlobs.push(blob);
        }
        mainImageBlob = imageCarouselBlobs[0];
      } else if (productVideo) {
        // Generate thumbnail from video
        setUploadProgress(10);
        const thumbnailBytes = await generateVideoThumbnail(productVideo);
        mainImageBlob = ExternalBlob.fromBytes(thumbnailBytes);
        setUploadProgress(30);

        // Upload video
        const videoBytes = await productVideo.arrayBuffer();
        videoBlob = ExternalBlob.fromBytes(new Uint8Array(videoBytes as ArrayBuffer)).withUploadProgress((percentage) => {
          setUploadProgress(30 + Math.round(percentage * 0.7));
        });
      } else {
        throw new Error('No media selected');
      }

      const product = {
        id: productId,
        storeId,
        name: productName.trim(),
        description: productDescription.trim(),
        price: BigInt(Math.round(Number(productPrice))),
        media: {
          mainImage: mainImageBlob,
          imageCarousel: imageCarouselBlobs,
          is3DModel: false,
          productVideo: videoBlob,
        },
        likeCount: BigInt(0),
        commentCount: BigInt(0),
        saveCount: BigInt(0),
        tier: ProductTier.stockProduct,
        monthlyPrice: BigInt(0),
      };

      createProduct(
        {
          productInput: product,
          storeMode,
          hasInstagramDiscount: false,
        },
        {
          onSuccess: () => {
            toast.success(t('store.productAddedSuccess'));
            resetForm();
            onOpenChange(false);
          },
          onError: (error: any) => {
            console.error('Product creation error:', error);
            toast.error(t('store.productAddedError') + ': ' + (error.message || 'Noma\'lum xatolik'));
            setUploadProgress(0);
          },
        }
      );
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Media processing error:', error);
      toast.error(t('store.mediaProcessError') + ': ' + (error.message || 'Noma\'lum xatolik'));
      setUploadProgress(0);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-gray-900 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="text-yellow-500 text-xl">+ {t('store.addProduct')}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          {/* Product Name */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="productName" className="text-gray-100">{t('store.productName')}</Label>
            <Input
              id="productName"
              value={productName}
              onChange={(e) => setProductName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('store.productNamePlaceholder')}
              required
              className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white placeholder:text-gray-400"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Product Price */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="productPrice" className="text-gray-100">{t('store.productPrice')}</Label>
            <Input
              id="productPrice"
              type="number"
              value={productPrice}
              onChange={(e) => setProductPrice(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('store.productPricePlaceholder')}
              required
              className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white placeholder:text-gray-400"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Product Description */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="productDescription" className="text-gray-100">{t('store.productDescription')}</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="productDescription"
              value={productDescription}
              onChange={(e) => setProductDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('store.productDescriptionPlaceholder')}
              rows={3}
              className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white placeholder:text-gray-400"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Product Images (up to 10) OR Video */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label className="text-gray-100">{t('store.productImages')} (10 tagacha)</Label>
            {productImages.length > 0 && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {productImages.map((img, index) => (
                  <div key={index} className="relative aspect-square">
                    <img
                      src={URL.createObjectURL(img)}
                      alt={`Product ${index + 1}`}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded border-2 border-yellow-500"
                    />
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="destructive"
                      size="icon"
                      className="absolute top-1 right-1 h-6 w-6"
                      onClick={(e) => removeImage(index, e)}
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            {productImages.length < 10 && !productVideo && (
              <Input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                multiple
                onChange={handleImageSelect}
                className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white file:text-white file:bg-gray-700 file:border-0"
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Product Video (30 seconds max) */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label className="text-gray-100">{t('store.productVideo')} (30 soniya)</Label>
            {productVideo && (
              <div className="p-2 bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 rounded">
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-300">{productVideo.name}</p>
              </div>
            )}
            {!productVideo && productImages.length === 0 && (
              <Input
                type="file"
                accept="video/*"
                onChange={handleVideoSelect}
                className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white file:text-white file:bg-gray-700 file:border-0"
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {uploadProgress > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Progress value={uploadProgress} />
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 text-center">
                {t('store.uploading')} {uploadProgress}%
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-4">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => {
                resetForm();
                onOpenChange(false);
              }}
              disabled={isPending}
              className="flex-1 border-yellow-500 text-yellow-500 hover:bg-yellow-500/10"
            >
              {t('common.cancel')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isPending}
              className="flex-1 bg-yellow-500 hover:bg-yellow-600 text-black font-semibold"
            >
              {isPending ? t('store.uploading') : t('store.addProduct')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/store/MapLocationPreview.tsx
================================================================================

import { MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';

interface MapLocationPreviewProps {
  locationUrl: string;
}

export default function MapLocationPreview({ locationUrl }: MapLocationPreviewProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();

  const handleClick = () => {
    window.open(locationUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  };

  // Extract coordinates from Google Maps URL if possible
  const getMapEmbedUrl = (url: string): string | null => {
    try {
      // Try to extract coordinates from various Google Maps URL formats
      const coordsMatch = url.match(/@(-?\d+\.\d+),(-?\d+\.\d+)/);
      if (coordsMatch) {
        const lat = coordsMatch[1];
        const lng = coordsMatch[2];
        return `https://www.google.com/maps/embed/v1/place?key=&q=${lat},${lng}&zoom=15`;
      }
      
      // Try place_id format
      const placeIdMatch = url.match(/place_id=([^&]+)/);
      if (placeIdMatch) {
        return `https://www.google.com/maps/embed/v1/place?key=&q=place_id:${placeIdMatch[1]}`;
      }
      
      return null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  const embedUrl = getMapEmbedUrl(locationUrl);

  return (
    <div
      onClick={handleClick}
      className="relative w-full h-48 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-yellow-500/40 cursor-pointer hover:border-yellow-500/60 transition-colors group"
    >
      {embedUrl ? (
        <iframe
          src={embedUrl}
          className="w-full h-full pointer-events-none"
          style={{ border: 0 }}
          loading="lazy"
          referrerPolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="w-full h-full bg-black/40 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <MapPin className="w-12 h-12 text-gold" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('store.mapPreviewUnavailable')}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Overlay with click hint */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/0 group-hover:bg-black/20 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-yellow-500/60 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-gold" />
            <span className="text-sm text-gold">{t('store.clickToOpenMap')}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/store/EditProductDialog.tsx
================================================================================

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Product } from '../../backend';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { useEditProductFields } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface EditProductDialogProps {
  product: Product | null;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}

export default function EditProductDialog({ product, open, onOpenChange }: EditProductDialogProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { mutate: editProduct, isPending } = useEditProductFields();

  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [price, setPrice] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (product) {
      setName(product.name);
      setDescription(product.description);
      setPrice(Number(product.price).toString());
    }
  }, [product]);

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!product) return;

    if (!name.trim()) {
      toast.error(t('store.enterProductName'));
      return;
    }

    if (!price.trim() || isNaN(Number(price)) || Number(price) < 0) {
      toast.error(t('store.enterValidPrice'));
      return;
    }

    editProduct(
      {
        productId: product.id,
        fields: {
          id: product.id,
          name: name.trim(),
          description: description.trim(),
          price: BigInt(Math.round(Number(price))),
        },
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(t('store.productEditedSuccess'));
          onOpenChange(false);
        },
        onError: (error: any) => {
          if (error.message?.includes('Unauthorized')) {
            toast.error(t('store.editUnauthorized'));
          } else {
            toast.error(t('store.productEditedError') + ': ' + error.message);
          }
        },
      }
    );
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    onOpenChange(false);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{t('store.editProduct')}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="edit-product-name">{t('store.productName')}</Label>
            <Input
              id="edit-product-name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('store.productNamePlaceholder')}
              disabled={isPending}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="edit-product-description">{t('store.productDescription')}</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="edit-product-description"
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('store.productDescriptionPlaceholder')}
              rows={4}
              disabled={isPending}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="edit-product-price">{t('store.productPrice')}</Label>
            <Input
              id="edit-product-price"
              type="number"
              value={price}
              onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('store.productPricePlaceholder')}
              disabled={isPending}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleCancel} disabled={isPending}>
            {t('common.cancel')}
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={isPending} className="gold-button">
            {isPending ? t('common.loading') : t('common.save')}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

================================================================================
FILE: frontend/src/components/store/StoreProfileForm.tsx
================================================================================

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useUpdateStoreProfile } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { ExternalBlob, StoreProfile, StoreImage } from '../../backend';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import MapLocationPreview from './MapLocationPreview';

interface StoreProfileFormProps {
  storeProfile: StoreProfile;
}

export default function StoreProfileForm({ storeProfile }: StoreProfileFormProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { mutate: updateProfile, isPending } = useUpdateStoreProfile();

  const [name, setName] = useState(storeProfile.name);
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(storeProfile.description);
  const [addressLink, setAddressLink] = useState(storeProfile.addressLink);

  // Media state - using StoreImage shape
  const [logoImage, setLogoImage] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [logoPreview, setLogoPreview] = useState<string | null>(
    storeProfile.media.logoImage?.getDirectURL() || null
  );

  const [storeImages, setStoreImages] = useState<Array<{ file: File | null; blob: ExternalBlob | null; description: string }>>([]);

  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);

  // Initialize store images from existing profile
  useEffect(() => {
    if (storeProfile.media.storeImages && storeProfile.media.storeImages.length > 0) {
      const existingImages = storeProfile.media.storeImages.map((storeImage) => ({
        file: null,
        blob: storeImage.blob,
        description: storeImage.description,
      }));
      setStoreImages(existingImages);
    }
  }, [storeProfile.media.storeImages]);

  const handleLogoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setLogoImage(file);
      setLogoPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    }
  };

  const handleStoreImagesSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    const totalImages = storeImages.length + files.length;
    
    if (totalImages > 10) {
      toast.error(t('store.maxStoreImages'));
      return;
    }

    const newImages = files.map((file) => ({
      file,
      blob: null,
      description: '',
    }));

    setStoreImages((prev) => [...prev, ...newImages]);
  };

  const removeStoreImage = (index: number) => {
    setStoreImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const updateStoreImageDescription = (index: number, description: string) => {
    setStoreImages((prev) =>
      prev.map((img, i) => (i === index ? { ...img, description } : img))
    );
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!name.trim()) {
      toast.error(t('store.enterStoreName'));
      return;
    }

    try {
      setUploadProgress(0);

      // Upload logo if new file selected
      let logoBlob: ExternalBlob | undefined = storeProfile.media.logoImage;
      if (logoImage) {
        const logoBytes = await logoImage.arrayBuffer();
        logoBlob = ExternalBlob.fromBytes(new Uint8Array(logoBytes)).withUploadProgress((percentage) => {
          setUploadProgress(Math.round(percentage * 0.4)); // 40% of total
        });
      }

      // Upload store images (up to 10) with captions
      const storeImageBlobs: StoreImage[] = [];
      const totalImages = storeImages.length;
      
      for (let i = 0; i < storeImages.length; i++) {
        const img = storeImages[i];
        
        if (img.file) {
          // New file - upload it
          const imageBytes = await img.file.arrayBuffer();
          const blob = ExternalBlob.fromBytes(new Uint8Array(imageBytes)).withUploadProgress((percentage) => {
            const baseProgress = 40 + ((i / totalImages) * 60);
            const imageProgress = (percentage / totalImages) * 60;
            setUploadProgress(Math.round(baseProgress + imageProgress));
          });
          storeImageBlobs.push({
            blob,
            description: img.description,
          });
        } else if (img.blob) {
          // Existing blob - keep it with updated description
          storeImageBlobs.push({
            blob: img.blob,
            description: img.description,
          });
        }
      }

      const updatedProfile: StoreProfile = {
        ...storeProfile,
        name: name.trim(),
        description: description.trim(),
        addressLink: addressLink.trim(),
        media: {
          logoImage: logoBlob,
          storeImages: storeImageBlobs,
          overviewVideo: undefined,
          storeInterior360: undefined,
        },
      };

      updateProfile(updatedProfile, {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(t('store.profileUpdatedSuccess'));
          setLogoImage(null);
          setUploadProgress(0);
        },
        onError: (error: any) => {
          toast.error(t('store.profileUpdatedError') + ': ' + error.message);
          setUploadProgress(0);
        },
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(t('store.mediaProcessError') + ': ' + error.message);
      setUploadProgress(0);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6 bg-gray-900 p-6 rounded-lg">
      {/* Store Information Heading with Black Background */}
      <div className="bg-black px-4 py-2 rounded-md -mx-6 -mt-6 mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">{t('store.enterStoreInformation')}</h2>
      </div>

      {/* Store Name */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="name" className="text-gray-100">{t('store.storeNameLabel')}</Label>
        <Input
          id="name"
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('store.storeNamePlaceholder')}
          required
          className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:border-yellow-400"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Logo Upload */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="logo" className="text-gray-100">{t('store.storeLogoLabel')}</Label>
        {logoPreview && (
          <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-yellow-500">
            <img src={logoPreview} alt={t('store.storeLogoLabel')} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
          </div>
        )}
        <Input
          id="logo"
          type="file"
          accept="image/*"
          onChange={handleLogoSelect}
          className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white file:text-white file:bg-gray-700 file:border-0"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Store Images Upload (up to 10) */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="storeImages" className="text-gray-100">{t('store.storeImagesLabel')}</Label>
        {storeImages.length > 0 && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {storeImages.map((img, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="space-y-2 relative">
                <div className="aspect-square bg-gray-800 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-yellow-500">
                  <img
                    src={img.file ? URL.createObjectURL(img.file) : img.blob?.getDirectURL()}
                    alt={`${t('store.storeImagesLabel')} ${index + 1}`}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  />
                </div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="destructive"
                  size="icon"
                  className="absolute top-2 right-2"
                  onClick={() => removeStoreImage(index)}
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
                <Input
                  placeholder={t('store.captionOptional')}
                  value={img.description}
                  onChange={(e) => updateStoreImageDescription(index, e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white placeholder:text-gray-400"
                />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        {storeImages.length < 10 && (
          <Input
            id="storeImages"
            type="file"
            accept="image/*"
            multiple
            onChange={handleStoreImagesSelect}
            className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white file:text-white file:bg-gray-700 file:border-0"
          />
        )}
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
          {storeImages.length} / 10 {t('store.imagesCount')}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Store Description */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="description" className="text-gray-100">{t('store.storeDescriptionLabel')}</Label>
        <Textarea
          id="description"
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('store.storeDescriptionPlaceholder')}
          rows={4}
          className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:border-yellow-400"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Store Location with Map Preview */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="addressLink" className="text-gray-100">{t('store.storeLocationLabel')}</Label>
        <Input
          id="addressLink"
          type="url"
          value={addressLink}
          onChange={(e) => setAddressLink(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t('store.enterMapLink')}
          className="bg-gray-800 border-2 border-yellow-500 text-white placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:border-yellow-400"
        />
        {addressLink && (
          <MapLocationPreview locationUrl={addressLink} />
        )}
      </div>

      {uploadProgress > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Progress value={uploadProgress} />
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 text-center">
            {t('store.uploading')} {uploadProgress}%
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <Button type="submit" disabled={isPending} className="w-full gold-button">
        {isPending ? t('store.updating') : t('store.saveButton')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import StoreAvatar from './StoreAvatar';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import type { StoreProfile } from '../../backend';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { MapPin } from 'lucide-react';

interface StoreIdentityRowProps {
  storeProfile: StoreProfile | null | undefined;
  storeId: string;
  showNavigation?: boolean;
  showProfileButton?: boolean;
}

export default function StoreIdentityRow({ 
  storeProfile, 
  storeId, 
  showNavigation = true,
  showProfileButton = false 
}: StoreIdentityRowProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleRowClick = () => {
    if (showNavigation) {
      navigate({ to: '/store/$storeId', params: { storeId } });
    }
  };

  const handleProfileClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    navigate({ to: '/store/$storeId', params: { storeId } });
  };

  const handleLocationClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
  };

  const hasAddressLink = storeProfile?.addressLink && storeProfile.addressLink.trim().length > 0;

  return (
    <div
      onClick={handleRowClick}
      className={`flex items-center gap-3 py-3 px-4 dark-row rounded-lg ${
        showNavigation ? 'cursor-pointer hover:bg-black/70 transition-colors' : ''
      }`}
    >
      <StoreAvatar storeProfile={storeProfile} size="md" />
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <p className="font-semibold text-sm truncate">
          {storeProfile?.name || t('common.loading')}
        </p>
        {hasAddressLink && (
          <a
            href={storeProfile.addressLink}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            onClick={handleLocationClick}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-gold hover:text-gold-light transition-colors mt-0.5"
          >
            <MapPin className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>View Location</span>
          </a>
        )}
      </div>
      {showProfileButton && (
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={handleProfileClick}
          className="shrink-0 text-xs"
        >
          Profile
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/store/MyStoreProductCard.tsx

import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { Product, ProductTier } from '../../backend';
import { Trash2, Pencil } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatPrice } from '../../utils/price';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import { stopEventPropagation } from '../../utils/eventGuards';
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

interface MyStoreProductCardProps {
  product: Product;
  onDelete: (productId: string) => void;
  onEdit: (product: Product) => void;
}

export default function MyStoreProductCard({ product, onDelete, onEdit }: MyStoreProductCardProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleCardClick = () => {
    navigate({ to: '/product/$productId', params: { productId: product.id } });
  };

  const handleEditClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    stopEventPropagation(e);
    onEdit(product);
  };

  const mainImageUrl = product.media.mainImage.getDirectURL();
  const isGolden = product.tier === ProductTier.goldenRegular || product.tier === ProductTier.goldenInstagramTagged;

  return (
    <div className={`relative group ${isGolden ? 'golden-elevated' : ''}`}>
      {/* Crown icon for Golden products */}
      {isGolden && (
        <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 z-10">
          <img 
            src="/assets/generated/crown-icon.dim_64x64.png" 
            alt="Golden" 
            className="w-8 h-8 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,215,0,0.8)]"
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Action buttons - always visible on touch devices, hover on desktop */}
      <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 z-20 flex gap-2 opacity-100 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
        {/* Edit button */}
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="secondary"
          size="icon"
          onClick={handleEditClick}
          onPointerDown={stopEventPropagation}
          onTouchStart={stopEventPropagation}
          className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white touch-manipulation"
        >
          <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
        </Button>

        {/* Delete button */}
        <AlertDialog>
          <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="destructive"
              size="icon"
              onClick={stopEventPropagation}
              onPointerDown={stopEventPropagation}
              onTouchStart={stopEventPropagation}
              className="touch-manipulation"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
          </AlertDialogTrigger>
          <AlertDialogContent onClick={stopEventPropagation}>
            <AlertDialogHeader>
              <AlertDialogTitle>{t('store.deleteProductTitle')}</AlertDialogTitle>
              <AlertDialogDescription>
                {t('store.deleteProductDescription')} {product.name}
              </AlertDialogDescription>
            </AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogFooter>
              <AlertDialogCancel>{t('common.cancel')}</AlertDialogCancel>
              <AlertDialogAction onClick={() => onDelete(product.id)}>
                {t('common.delete')}
              </AlertDialogAction>
            </AlertDialogFooter>
          </AlertDialogContent>
        </AlertDialog>
      </div>

      <div
        onClick={handleCardClick}
        className="cursor-pointer"
      >
        <div className={`relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted ${isGolden ? 'golden-border' : ''}`}>
          <img
            src={mainImageUrl}
            alt={product.name}
            className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300"
          />
        </div>

        <div className={`mt-2 p-3 rounded-b-lg ${isGolden ? 'golden-shimmer-frame' : 'product-frame-dark'}`}>
          <h3 className={`font-semibold text-sm line-clamp-2 mb-1 ${isGolden ? 'text-black' : ''}`}>
            {product.name}
          </h3>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className={`font-bold ${isGolden ? 'text-black' : 'text-gold'}`}>
              {formatPrice(product.price)}
            </p>
            {isGolden && product.monthlyPrice > BigInt(0) && (
              <p className="text-xs text-black/70 font-medium">
                ${Number(product.monthlyPrice) / 100}/mo
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

================================================================================

import { StoreProfile } from '../../backend';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';
import StoreAvatar from './StoreAvatar';
import MapLocationPreview from './MapLocationPreview';

interface StoreInformationDisplayProps {
  storeProfile: StoreProfile;
}

export default function StoreInformationDisplay({ storeProfile }: StoreInformationDisplayProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();

  return (

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Store Description */}
      {storeProfile.description && (
        <div className="space-y-2">

        </div>
      )}

      {storeProfile.media.storeImages.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <h4 className="font-semibold text-gold">{t('store.storeGallery')}</h4>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {storeProfile.media.storeImages.map((image, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="space-y-1">
                <div className="aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border">
                  <img
                    src={image.blob.getDirectURL()}
                    alt={image.description || `${t('store.storeImagesLabel')} ${index + 1}`}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  />
                </div>
                {image.description && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{image.description}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Store Location */}
      {storeProfile.addressLink && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h4 className="font-semibold text-gold">{t('store.storeLocation')}</h4>
          <MapLocationPreview locationUrl={storeProfile.addressLink} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/products/ProductActionBar.tsx
================================================================================

import { Heart, MessageCircle, Bookmark } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLikeProduct, useSaveProduct, useUnsaveProduct, useCreateChatThread } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { Principal } from '@dfinity/principal';
import type { Product } from '../../backend';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface ProductActionBarProps {
  product: Product;
}

export default function ProductActionBar({ product }: ProductActionBarProps) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { mutate: likeProduct } = useLikeProduct();
  const { mutate: saveProduct } = useSaveProduct();
  const { mutate: unsaveProduct } = useUnsaveProduct();
  const { mutate: createChatThread } = useCreateChatThread();
  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);

  const handleLike = () => {
    likeProduct(product.id, {
      onError: (error: any) => {
        if (error.message?.includes('already liked')) {
          toast.error('Already liked');
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (isSaved) {
      unsaveProduct(product.id);
      setIsSaved(false);
    } else {
      saveProduct(product.id);
      setIsSaved(true);
    }
  };

  const handleMessage = () => {
    createChatThread(
      { storeId: Principal.fromText(product.storeId), productId: product.id },
      {
        onSuccess: (threadId) => {
          navigate({ to: '/chat/$threadId', params: { threadId } });
        },
        onError: (error: any) => {
          toast.error('Failed to start chat: ' + error.message);
        },
      }
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="absolute right-4 bottom-4 flex flex-col gap-4">
      <button
        onClick={handleLike}
        className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 bg-card/90 backdrop-blur rounded-full p-3 border border-border hover:bg-card transition-colors"
      >
        <Heart className="w-6 h-6 gold-icon" />
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold">{Number(product.likeCount)}</span>
      </button>

      <button
        onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/product/$productId/comments', params: { productId: product.id } })}
        className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 bg-card/90 backdrop-blur rounded-full p-3 border border-border hover:bg-card transition-colors"
      >
        <MessageCircle className="w-6 h-6 gold-icon" />
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold">{Number(product.commentCount)}</span>
      </button>

      <button
        onClick={handleSave}
        className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 bg-card/90 backdrop-blur rounded-full p-3 border border-border hover:bg-card transition-colors"
      >
        <Bookmark className={`w-6 h-6 ${isSaved ? 'fill-current gold-icon' : 'gold-icon'}`} />
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold">{Number(product.saveCount)}</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
FILE: frontend/src/components/products/ProductMediaCarousel.tsx
================================================================================

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

interface ProductMediaCarouselProps {
  images: string[];
  alt: string;
}

export default function ProductMediaCarousel({ images, alt }: ProductMediaCarouselProps) {
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [touchStart, setTouchStart] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [touchEnd, setTouchEnd] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const minSwipeDistance = 50;

  const goToPrevious = () => {
    setCurrentIndex((prev) => (prev === 0 ? images.length - 1 : prev - 1));
  };

  const goToNext = () => {
    setCurrentIndex((prev) => (prev === images.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1));
  };

  const onTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    setTouchEnd(null);
    setTouchStart(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  };

  const onTouchMove = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    setTouchEnd(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  };

  const onTouchEnd = () => {
    if (!touchStart || !touchEnd) return;
    
    const distance = touchStart - touchEnd;
    const isLeftSwipe = distance > minSwipeDistance;
    const isRightSwipe = distance < -minSwipeDistance;

    if (isLeftSwipe) {
      goToNext();
    } else if (isRightSwipe) {
      goToPrevious();
    }
  };

  if (images.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  if (images.length === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="aspect-[3/4] bg-muted">
        <img src={images[0]} alt={alt} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div 
      className="relative aspect-[3/4] bg-muted"
      onTouchStart={onTouchStart}
      onTouchMove={onTouchMove}
      onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd}
    >
      <img 
        src={images[currentIndex]} 
        alt={`${alt} - ${currentIndex + 1}`} 
        className="w-full h-full object-cover" 
      />
      
      {/* Navigation Buttons */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-between p-4 pointer-events-none">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="icon"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            goToPrevious();
          }}
          className="pointer-events-auto bg-black/50 hover:bg-black/70 text-white border-none"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="icon"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            goToNext();
          }}
          className="pointer-events-auto bg-black/50 hover:bg-black/70 text-white border-none"
        >
          <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5" />
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Indicator Dots */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-0 right-0 flex justify-center gap-2">
        {images.map((_, index) => (
          <button
            key={index}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setCurrentIndex(index);
            }}
            className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full transition-all ${
              index === currentIndex 
                ? 'bg-white w-6' 
                : 'bg-white/50'
            }`}
            aria-label={`Go to image ${index + 1}`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/products/ProductsAiChatWindow.tsx
================================================================================

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSearchProductsForAssistant } from '../../hooks/useQueries';
import { Button } from '../ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '../ui/textarea';
import { Send, Image as ImageIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { useI18n } from '../../i18n/i18n';

interface Message {
  id: string;
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  content: string;
  timestamp: number;
}

interface ProductsAiChatWindowProps {
  onSearch?: (query: string) => void;
}

export default function ProductsAiChatWindow({ onSearch }: ProductsAiChatWindowProps) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const messagesContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const { mutate: searchProducts, isPending } = useSearchProductsForAssistant();

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollToBottom();
  }, [messages]);

  const handleSend = () => {
    const trimmedInput = inputValue.trim();
    if (!trimmedInput || isPending) return;

    const userMessage: Message = {
      id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
      role: 'user',
      content: trimmedInput,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMessage]);
    setInputValue('');

    // Notify parent about search query
    if (onSearch) {
      onSearch(trimmedInput);
    }

    searchProducts(
      { searchTerm: trimmedInput },
      {
        onSuccess: (result) => {
          const assistantMessage: Message = {
            id: `assistant-${Date.now()}`,
            role: 'assistant',
            content: result.assistantAnswer,
            timestamp: Date.now(),
          };
          setMessages(prev => [...prev, assistantMessage]);
        },
        onError: (error) => {
          const errorMessage: Message = {
            id: `error-${Date.now()}`,
            role: 'assistant',
            content: t('assistant.genericError'),
            timestamp: Date.now(),
          };
          setMessages(prev => [...prev, errorMessage]);
        },
      }
    );
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSend();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm border border-yellow-500/40 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
      {/* Messages Area */}
      <div 
        ref={messagesContainerRef}
        className="h-[200px] overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3"
      >
        {messages.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full">
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm text-center">
              {t('products.chatWindowEmpty')}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          messages.map((message) => (
            <div
              key={message.id}
              className={`flex ${message.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
            >
              <div
                className={`max-w-[80%] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 ${
                  message.role === 'user'
                    ? 'bg-yellow-500/60 backdrop-blur-sm border border-yellow-500'
                    : 'bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm border border-yellow-500'
                }`}
              >
                <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{message.content}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Input Area */}
      <div className="border-t border-yellow-500/40 p-3 bg-black/40">
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="icon"
            className="flex-shrink-0 border-yellow-500/40 hover:bg-yellow-500/20"
            disabled
          >
            <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
          
          <Textarea
            value={inputValue}
            onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            placeholder={t('products.aiSearchPlaceholder')}
            className="min-h-[40px] max-h-[100px] resize-none bg-black/40 border-yellow-500/40"
            disabled={isPending}
          />
          
          <Button
            onClick={handleSend}
            disabled={!inputValue.trim() || isPending}
            className="flex-shrink-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm border-2 border-yellow-500 hover:bg-yellow-500/20"
          >
            <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  const [isEditDialogOpen, setIsEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [productToEdit, setProductToEdit] = useState<Product | null>(null);

  const isGoldenStore = storeProfile?.mode === StoreMode.golden;
  const isStockStore = storeProfile?.mode === StoreMode.stock;
  const currentProductCount = products?.length || 0;

  const handleBecomeSeller = () => {
    if (!identity) {
      toast.error(t('store.loginRequired'));
      return;
    }

    if (isSellerConsentFetched && hasSellerConsent === false) {
      setShowSellerConsentModal(true);
      return;
    }

    proceedWithBecomeSeller();
  };

  const handleSellerConsentConfirm = () => {
    acceptConsent(
      {
        consentType: ConsentType.sellerOnboarding,
        acceptanceData: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          setShowSellerConsentModal(false);
          proceedWithBecomeSeller();
        },
        onError: (error: any) => {
          toast.error(t('store.consentError') + ': ' + error.message);
        },
      }
    );
  };

  const proceedWithBecomeSeller = () => {
    if (!identity) return;
    
    const principal = identity.getPrincipal();
    becomeSeller(
      {
        owner: principal,
        name: '',
        description: '',
        addressLink: '',
        assistantKnowledge: '',
        media: {
          logoImage: undefined,
          storeImages: [],
          overviewVideo: undefined,
          storeInterior360: undefined,
        },
        mode: StoreMode.stock,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(t('store.storeCreatedSuccess'));
        },
        onError: (error: any) => {
          if (error.message?.includes('already exists')) {
            toast.error(t('store.storeAlreadyExists'));
          } else {
            toast.error(t('store.storeCreatedError') + ': ' + error.message);
          }
        },
      }
    );
  };

  const handleEditProduct = (product: Product) => {
    setProductToEdit(product);
    setIsEditDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDeleteProduct = (productId: string) => {
    if (confirm('Mahsulotni o\'chirmoqchimisiz?')) {
      deleteProduct(productId, {
        onSuccess: () => {
          toast.success(t('store.productDeletedSuccess'));
        },
        onError: (error: any) => {
          toast.error(t('store.productDeletedError') + ': ' + error.message);
        },
      });
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t('common.loading')}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!storeProfile) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-screen p-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="text-center space-y-4 max-w-md">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold glossy-yellow-text">{t('store.becomeSellerTitle')}</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t('store.becomeSellerDescription')}</p>
          <Button
            onClick={handleBecomeSeller}
            disabled={isBecoming}
            className="gold-button"
          >
            {isBecoming ? t('common.loading') : t('store.becomeSeller')}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {showSellerConsentModal && (
          <ConsentModal
            open={showSellerConsentModal}
            onConfirm={handleSellerConsentConfirm}
            isLoading={isAcceptingConsent}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen pb-20">
      <MyStoreHeader />

      <div className="p-4 space-y-6">
        {/* Store Information Button */}
        <Dialog open={isStoreInfoDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setIsStoreInfoDialogOpen}>
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button className="w-full gold-button">
              {t('store.storeInformationButton')}
            </Button>
          </DialogTrigger>
          <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto bg-gray-900 border-2 border-yellow-500">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle className="text-yellow-500 text-xl">{t('store.storeInformation')}</DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <StoreProfileForm storeProfile={storeProfile} />
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>

        {/* Golden AI Assistant Section */}
        {isGoldenStore && (
          <div className="dark-label-surface p-4 rounded-lg space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 dark-label-surface p-3 rounded-lg">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold glossy-yellow-text">{t('store.goldenAssistant')}</h2>
            </div>
            <GoldenAssistantImageUpload />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Upgrade Control for Stock Stores */}
        {isStockStore && <UpgradeToGoldenControl />}

        {/* Products Section */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between dark-label-surface p-3 rounded-lg">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold glossy-yellow-text">{t('store.myProducts')}</h2>
            <Button
              onClick={() => setIsAddDialogOpen(true)}
              className="gold-button flex items-center gap-2"
              disabled={isStockStore && currentProductCount >= 10}
            >
              <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />
              {t('store.addProduct')}
            </Button>
          </div>

          {isStockStore && currentProductCount >= 10 && (
            <p className="text-sm text-yellow-500">{t('store.stockLimitReached')}</p>
          )}

          {products && products.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {products.map((product) => (
                <MyStoreProductCard
                  key={product.id}
                  product={product}
                  onEdit={() => handleEditProduct(product)}
                  onDelete={() => handleDeleteProduct(product.id)}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-12 dark-label-surface rounded-lg">
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t('store.noProducts')}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Create Product Dialog */}
      <CreateProductDialog
        open={isAddDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsAddDialogOpen}
        storeMode={storeProfile.mode}
      />

      {/* Edit Product Dialog */}
      {productToEdit && (
        <EditProductDialog
          open={isEditDialogOpen}
          onOpenChange={setIsEditDialogOpen}
          product={productToEdit}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useParams, useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useAddComment, useGetProductComments, useGetProduct } from '../hooks/useQueries';
import { useInternetIdentity } from '../hooks/useInternetIdentity';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

export default function ProductCommentsPage() {
  const { productId } = useParams({ from: '/product/$productId/comments' });
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { identity } = useInternetIdentity();
  const [comment, setComment] = useState('');
  
  const { data: product } = useGetProduct(productId);
  const { data: comments = [], isLoading: commentsLoading } = useGetProductComments(productId);
  const { mutate: addComment, isPending } = useAddComment();

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (comment.trim()) {
      addComment(
        { productId, content: comment.trim() },
        {
          onSuccess: () => {
            toast.success('Comment added');
            setComment('');
          },
          onError: (error: any) => {
            toast.error('Failed to add comment: ' + error.message);
          },
        }
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background pb-20">
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-40 bg-background/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-border">
        <div className="flex items-center px-4 py-3">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/product/$productId', params: { productId } })}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </Button>
          <h1 className="ml-2 font-semibold gold-text">Comments</h1>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
        {/* Add Comment Section */}
        <div className="bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg border border-border p-4 space-y-3">
          <Textarea
            value={comment}
            onChange={(e) => setComment(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Write your comment..."
            className="min-h-[100px]"
          />
          <Button 
            onClick={handleSubmit} 
            disabled={isPending || !comment.trim()} 
            className="w-full gold-button"
          >
            {isPending ? 'Adding...' : 'Add Comment'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Comments List */}
        <div className="bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg border border-border p-4">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold gold-text mb-4">
            All Comments ({comments.length})
          </h2>
          
          {commentsLoading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">Loading comments...</div>
          ) : comments.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
              No comments yet. Be the first to comment!
            </div>
          ) : (
            <ScrollArea className="h-[500px] pr-4">
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {comments.map((c) => {
                  const isOwnComment = identity?.getPrincipal().toString() === c.author.toString();
                  const timestamp = new Date(Number(c.timestamp) / 1000000);
                  
                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={c.id} 
                      className={`p-3 rounded-lg border ${
                        isOwnComment 
                          ? 'bg-gold/10 border-gold/30' 
                          : 'bg-muted/50 border-border'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground truncate">
                            {c.author.toString().slice(0, 12)}...
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
                          {timestamp.toLocaleDateString()} {timestamp.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">
                        {c.content}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </ScrollArea>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/MyStoreMessagesPage.tsx

import { useNavigate, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useGetUserChatThreads, useMarkNotificationAsRead, useGetUnreadNotifications } from '../hooks/useQueries';
import { useInternetIdentity } from '../hooks/useInternetIdentity';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { MessageCircle, ArrowLeft, Bell } from 'lucide-react';
import { useI18n } from '../i18n/i18n';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import ChatThreadProductContextRow from '../components/chat/ChatThreadProductContextRow';

export default function MyStoreMessagesPage() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { identity } = useInternetIdentity();
  const search = useSearch({ from: '/my-store/messages' }) as { notificationId?: string };
  
  const { data: threads, isLoading } = useGetUserChatThreads();
  const { data: unreadNotifications } = useGetUnreadNotifications();
  const markAsReadMutation = useMarkNotificationAsRead();

  const currentUserPrincipal = identity?.getPrincipal().toString();

  // Mark notification as read when arriving from notification
  useEffect(() => {
    if (search.notificationId) {
      markAsReadMutation.mutate(search.notificationId);
    }
  }, [search.notificationId]);

  // Filter threads where current user is the store owner
  const myStoreThreads = threads?.filter(
    (thread) => thread.store.toString() === currentUserPrincipal
  ) || [];

  const ongoingThreads = myStoreThreads.filter((t) => 
    t.status.__kind__ === 'ongoing' || t.status.__kind__ === 'takenOver'
  );
  const endedThreads = myStoreThreads.filter((t) => t.status.__kind__ === 'ended');

  // Filter human request notifications
  const humanRequestNotifications = unreadNotifications?.filter(
    (n) => n.notificationType.__kind__ === 'humanSellerRequested'
  ) || [];

  const handleNotificationClick = (notification: any) => {
    // Extract threadId from notification message if available
    const threadIdMatch = notification.message.match(/thread: (.+)$/);
    if (threadIdMatch) {
      const threadId = threadIdMatch[1];
      markAsReadMutation.mutate(notification.id);
      navigate({ to: '/chat/$threadId', params: { threadId } });
    }
  };

  const ThreadList = ({ threads }: { threads: typeof myStoreThreads }) => {
    if (threads.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground">
          {t('chat.noThreads')}
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {threads.map((thread) => {
          const lastMessage = thread.messages[thread.messages.length - 1];
          const buyerPrincipal = thread.buyer.toString();
          const buyerShortName = buyerPrincipal.slice(0, 8);
          const buyerInitial = buyerShortName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
          const isTakenOver = thread.status.__kind__ === 'takenOver';

          return (
            <button
              key={thread.id}
              onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/chat/$threadId', params: { threadId: thread.id } })}
              className="w-full bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg p-4 border border-border hover:border-gold transition-colors text-left"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <Avatar className="w-10 h-10">
                  <AvatarFallback className="bg-gold/20 text-gold font-semibold">
                    {buyerInitial}
                  </AvatarFallback>
                </Avatar>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                    <h3 className="font-semibold glossy-yellow-text truncate">
                      {t('chat.buyer')}: {buyerPrincipal.slice(0, 12)}...
                    </h3>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {isTakenOver && (
                        <Badge variant="default" className="text-xs">
                          Human
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                      <MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {thread.productId && (
                    <div className="mb-1">
                      <ChatThreadProductContextRow productId={thread.productId} />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {lastMessage && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground truncate">
                      {lastMessage.content}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen">
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-background/95 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60 border-b border-border">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 p-4">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/my-store' })}
            className="shrink-0"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </Button>
          <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold glossy-yellow-text">{t('myStore.messages')}</h1>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
        {/* Human Request Notifications */}
        {humanRequestNotifications.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gold flex items-center gap-2">
              <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
              Customer Requests ({humanRequestNotifications.length})
            </h2>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {humanRequestNotifications.map((notification) => (
                <button
                  key={notification.id}
                  onClick={() => handleNotificationClick(notification)}
                  className="w-full bg-gold/10 border border-gold/30 rounded-lg p-3 text-left hover:bg-gold/20 transition-colors"
                >
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gold">
                    {notification.message}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                    {new Date(Number(notification.timestamp) / 1000000).toLocaleString()}
                  </p>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground">{t('common.loading')}</div>
        ) : (
          <Tabs defaultValue="ongoing" className="w-full">
            <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-2 mb-4">
              <TabsTrigger value="ongoing">{t('chat.ongoing')} ({ongoingThreads.length})</TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="ended">{t('chat.ended')} ({endedThreads.length})</TabsTrigger>
            </TabsList>
            <TabsContent value="ongoing">
              <ThreadList threads={ongoingThreads} />
            </TabsContent>
            <TabsContent value="ended">
              <ThreadList threads={endedThreads} />
            </TabsContent>
          </Tabs>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/ChatThreadPage.tsx
================================================================================

import { useParams, useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useGetChatThread, useSendChatMessage, useEndChatThread, useSellerTakeoverChat } from '../hooks/useQueries';
import { useInternetIdentity } from '../hooks/useInternetIdentity';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { ArrowLeft, Send, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { useI18n } from '../i18n/i18n';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import ChatMessageBubble from '../components/chat/ChatMessageBubble';
import ChatProductContextHeader from '../components/chat/ChatProductContextHeader';

export default function ChatThreadPage() {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  const { threadId } = useParams({ from: '/chat/$threadId' });
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { identity } = useInternetIdentity();
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const { data: thread, isLoading, refetch } = useGetChatThread(threadId);
  const sendMessageMutation = useSendChatMessage();
  const endThreadMutation = useEndChatThread();
  const takeoverMutation = useSellerTakeoverChat();

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollToBottom();
  }, [thread?.messages]);

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!message.trim() || sendMessageMutation.isPending) return;

    try {
      await sendMessageMutation.mutateAsync({ threadId, content: message.trim() });
      setMessage('');
      toast.success(t('chat.messageSent'));
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.message || t('common.error'));
    }
  };

  const handleEndChat = async () => {
    try {
      await endThreadMutation.mutateAsync(threadId);
      toast.success(t('chat.chatEnded'));
      navigate({ to: '/chats' });
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.message || t('common.error'));
    }
  };

  const handleTakeover = async () => {
    try {
      await takeoverMutation.mutateAsync(threadId);
      toast.success('You have taken over the conversation');
      // Refetch to show the system message
      await refetch();
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.message || t('common.error'));
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSend();
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-muted-foreground">{t('common.loading')}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!thread) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4">
        <div className="text-muted-foreground">{t('chat.notFound')}</div>
        <Button onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/chats' })} variant="outline">
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
          {t('common.back')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isOngoing = thread.status.__kind__ === 'ongoing';
  const isTakenOver = thread.status.__kind__ === 'takenOver';
  const currentUserPrincipal = identity?.getPrincipal().toString();
  const isStoreSeller = thread.store.toString() === currentUserPrincipal;
  const canTakeover = isStoreSeller && isOngoing && !isTakenOver;
  const canSendMessage = isOngoing || isTakenOver;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-screen">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-background/95 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60 border-b border-border">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon"
              onClick={() => navigate({ to: '/chats' })}
              className="shrink-0"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
            </Button>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold glossy-yellow-text">{t('chat.title')}</h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {isTakenOver 
                  ? 'Human Seller' 
                  : isOngoing 
                  ? t('chat.statusOngoing') 
                  : t('chat.statusEnded')}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {canTakeover && (
              <Button
                onClick={handleTakeover}
                disabled={takeoverMutation.isPending}
                variant="default"
                size="sm"
              >
                <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                {takeoverMutation.isPending ? t('common.loading') : 'Take Over'}
              </Button>
            )}
            {isOngoing && (
              <Button
                onClick={handleEndChat}
                disabled={endThreadMutation.isPending}
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
              >
                {endThreadMutation.isPending ? t('common.loading') : t('chat.endChat')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Product Context Header */}
      {thread.productId && <ChatProductContextHeader productId={thread.productId} />}

      {/* Messages */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4">
        {thread.messages.map((msg) => {
          const isSystemMessage = msg.content.includes('The store seller has taken over');
          
          if (isSystemMessage) {
            return (
              <div key={msg.id} className="flex justify-center">
                <div className="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm border border-[oklch(0.85_0.15_85)] text-foreground text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-full max-w-[80%] text-center">
                  Do'kon sotuvchisi suxbatni o'z zimmasiga oldi endi siz AI bilan emas inson bilan suxbatlashyabsiz!!!
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          }

          return (
            <ChatMessageBubble
              key={msg.id}
              message={msg}
              isOutgoing={msg.sender.toString() === currentUserPrincipal}
            />
          );
        })}
        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Input Area */}
      {canSendMessage && (
        <div className="border-t border-border dark-label-surface p-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Textarea
              value={message}
              onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
              placeholder={t('chat.messagePlaceholder')}
              className="min-h-[60px] resize-none"
              disabled={sendMessageMutation.isPending}
            />
            <Button
              onClick={handleSend}
              disabled={!message.trim() || sendMessageMutation.isPending}
              size="icon"
              className="shrink-0 h-[60px] w-[60px] gold-button"
            >
              <Send className="w-5 h-5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
            {t('chat.sendHint')}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
